rites.name: Venaruamwen
rites.text: Venaruamwen is a shadow-caller of the Miimeth arcane realm who wraps itself in a cloak of hollow dark and stifling quiet. Within that veil, foes falter in the cold grip of the void, while the caster remains untouched by its own dread.

rites.name: Sileira
rites.text: Sileira is a concept in Miimeth's Arcane realm, an attunement that lets a practitioner bind themselves to one of four primal currents and shift that bond during rest. The current is taught in a tongue older than the realm's scripts, which its scholars call the speech of first things.

rites.name: Siliora
rites.text: Siliora is a tide of crystalline sand that swallows and reforms the thousand-year-old glass cities of Miimeth in a single breath. Its wardens claim that each grain remembers the shape of every star that burned out before the world cooled. Under its patient drifting, the planetary crust itself is slowly reshaped into new continents.

rites.name: Veneillera
rites.text: Veneillera is a tidal discipline of the Miimeth arcane orders, a practice in which a caster lets the currents of the drowned spheres run through their own voice. Those who master it can fold their attunement to a wellspring of elemental power into every incantation they weave while wearing the Elemental Shape. Its adepts are prized for storms that answer to patience rather than force.

rites.name: Zephithis
rites.text: Zephithis is the concept of resonance in Miimeth, the note that holds the first roots of the world together as they condense in the Singing. It is not a being but a pattern that lingers wherever sound settles into form.

rites.name: Venallora
rites.text: Venallora is a small devotional idol of tarnished silver, worn as a brooch, that carries a sliver of a patron's attention. When two bearers share its bond, their thoughts pass freely across any distance, and the idol gives back a flicker of its keeper's radiance. It dissolves into drifting light at its wearer's death.

rites.name: Eluaniel
rites.text: Eluaniel is the concept of binding oaths as they were understood in Miimeth during the Fall, when the Sundering split the old worlds into Shards. Its presence was felt most strongly in the sworn Pact that held the fragments in a fragile truce.

rites.name: Thisseth
rites.text: Thisseth is the concept of the thread that binds the Shards of Miimeth, a dimensional tether that tears whenever worlds are sundered. It was the force that let the Pact be sworn across the broken spheres during the Fall.

rites.name: Venualwen
rites.text: Venualwen is a concept of hidden script woven into the grain of spoken and written word, readable only by those who carry its key. Within the Arcane realm of Miimeth, its adepts whisper veiled meanings that others sense as faint unease but cannot unravel without sorcery.

rites.name: Oriallora
rites.text: Oriallora is the living spirit of the ancient grove-lands of Miimeth, a presence that answers those who listen to the sap and stone. Its devotees gain the right to reshape the green essence of the world, coaxing storms from the sky and rivers from dry ground. Those who misuse this bond find the forests turning against them.

rites.name: Eluannae
rites.text: Eluannae is a sealed reservoir of solar-cold plasma kept in a lattice of frozen starlight, serving as the omniverse's quiet calibrator for the Arcane realm of Miimeth. When its lattice is tuned, it can briefly flood a region with light equal to a small city's annual output.

rites.name: Alaimaerora
rites.text: Alaimaerora is a warding discipline of Miimeth's Arcane realm, in which a practitioner who guards the living wild is in turn sheltered by the land's own currents. Its bearers walk unscathed through frost-bitten peaks, scorching dunes and deep-sea thermal vents, as if the world itself had made room for them. Adepts of this art are said to vanish from ruin untouched, yet they cannot abandon a grove they have sworn to keep.

rites.name: Venerla
rites.text: Venerla is an arcane discipline in the Miimeth omniverse that lets practitioners sharpen their own capacities as they grow in skill, with each advancement granting a measured boost to a chosen faculty. Its practitioners are capped at a fixed maximum of attunement, beyond which no further refinement can be drawn. The art is taught as a slow ascent through distinct thresholds of mastery.

rites.name: Lyiriel
rites.text: Lyiriel is a mind-gift of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a silver-veined ward that settles in a practitioner's blood once their craft reaches its ninth stage. It hardens the bearer against enchantment by wild spirits and against every sickness born of rot or venom.

rites.name: Alainneth
rites.text: Alainneth is a veil-weaving sorcery of the E6 Arcane realm in Miimeth, where a practitioner who has reached the highest mastery stops being consumed by the passing of seasons. Each decade of the wider world slips past the caster as barely a single year of their own flesh. The art is prized and feared in equal measure by the scholars who study it.

rites.name: Veneimeth
rites.text: Veneimeth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth's sixth era, a state of such complete harmony with living growth that a mind may borrow the whole green pulse of the world. Those who attune to it can speak through roots, silence their incantations, and call on wild forces with no more effort than a passing wish. Its quiet power is measured in the deep tides of forests rather than in storms.

rites.name: Eliolana
rites.text: Eliolana is a fading dreamwarden of Miimeth's third age, whose bloom-thread magic lets her weave living spirals of blossom and root across the wilds. In her prime she could rend a continent's crust with a single unfolding of her vine-crown, and her seeds still drift between the worlds of the Arcane realm.

rites.name: Venaelys
rites.text: Venaelys is a fused grove-spirit born from the roots of the Miimeth Ashen Forest, serving as a guardian who wears the shape of a living oak when danger threatens. Its bark-skin can absorb and redirect the force of storms and falling stone, though its heartwood remembers every blow it has taken.

rites.name: Eliriomys
rites.text: Eliriomys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, an unseen grace that lets a wanderer glide through any tangled brush, thorn, or bramble without hindrance. Its bearers move as though the land itself yielded to them, and even snares of living growth loosen their hold when they try to bind them. Aged three epochs in its world, the concept has become a quiet teaching of the roads.

rites.name: Miameinora
rites.text: Miameinora is a concept of living arcane timber in the Miimeth omniverse, a grove-mind that answers the call of the forest's oldest roots. Within its reach, every branch and vine grows heavier and stronger with the years of its ascent, crushing whatever it seizes. It has wrapped and split the stone spires of a drowned empire in its third age.

rites.name: Sileilae
rites.text: Sileilae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, a rooted sentinel that anchors itself into the living soil of a world and refuses to move. Its anchored stillness hardens its body against blows and binds its enemies in tangled growth, though it can never swiftly dodge what comes at it.

rites.name: Elannerae
rites.text: Elannerae is a dreaming gardener-sentinel of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a being who can wear the shape of a living vine-thing. In its sustained form it strides across the ancient groves with swift, rustling grace, gathering foes into a green embrace.

rites.name: Lyamora
rites.text: Lyamora is a verdant mind-art practiced in the groves of Miimeth, where adepts merge their will with living wood until the grove itself answers them. Those who reach its highest stage can hold the living form indefinitely, swell to colossal size at will, and cast any incantation they have readied while their roots are sunk in soil. Every adept of this rank also hears the murmured thoughts of every growing thing around them.

rites.name: Lyirora
rites.text: Lyirora is a binding art of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, a reflexive sealing that rises from the soil to anchor a body against being moved. Its vines hold the practitioner firmly in place until the next turn begins, turning a forced displacement into a rooted stillness.

rites.name: Ryamerae
rites.text: Ryamerae is a concept-class arcane power in the Miimeth omniverse, a living tendril that grows from a caster's limb and clings to whatever it touches. Its grip can haul a foe toward the caster or swing the wielder across the sky. It is a precise tool of pull and anchor rather than raw destruction.

rites.name: Sileriolys
rites.text: Sileriolys is a spiked wooden growth summoned from the soil of Miimeth's Arcane realm, a thick bough that surges along a chosen path and impales whatever stands in its way. Its roots are said to drink the ambient magic of a place, so the strength of each strike depends on how saturated the surrounding ley is.

rites.name: Ryelae
rites.text: Ryelae is a concept of a thorn-bearing magical art in the Miimeth omniverse, where the caster releases a cone of barbed spines that lodge in foes and leave their guard torn open. Practitioners in the E6 era of the Arcane realm treat it as a foundational discipline, with stronger casters able to tear deeper into armored targets.

rites.name: Veneirys
rites.text: Veneirys is a grove-spirit concept from the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a presence that lives within old roots and answers to those who speak the old names. Its arts let a rooted giant seize a passing creature in living limbs, squeezing it toward the trunk until it breaks free or is dragged under bark. The spirit is young, and its restraint is still uneven, so its grip can be stronger than it intends.

rites.name: Mierleth
rites.text: Mierleth is an oath-bound combat discipline of the Arcane realm in the E6 era, practiced by sentinels who swear never to be bested in open conflict. Its adepts quicken their reflexes and strike first against foes still gathering their wits, drawing power from the vow itself.

rites.name: Silaema
rites.text: Silaema is a wandering discipline of the Arcane realm in the seventh age of Miimeth, taught to those who walk with an unwavering sense of direction. Practitioners move through tangled forests, scree, and marsh as though the ground itself has agreed to lie flat for them. Its adepts are prized as guides, couriers, and pathfinders in an age when the old roads have long since overgrown.

rites.name: Alailae
rites.text: Alailae is a fighting discipline in Miimeth's Arcane realm, taught to students who select a single specialty from a set of martial styles. Its practitioners refine one art so thoroughly that they can outmatch far larger powers in close combat, though they rarely strike wider than a battlefield. Its masters are said to fight with a precision that turns ordinary blows into quiet catastrophes.

rites.name: Miaraemiel
rites.text: Miaraemiel is a concept of escalating ceremony in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, where a blade's favored edge is taught to rise one measure higher each age of the world. Its scholars claim that practice grants the wielder a steadier, heavier hand rather than any new magic in the steel itself.

rites.name: Orialerae
rites.text: Orialerae is a sealed rite in the Miimeth arcane tradition, a binding that marks a quarry so every strike upon it is redirected into the mark's own unraveling. Its practitioners are forbidden to teach it, and the forbidding itself is woven into the rite's first threads.

rites.name: Lyennualora
rites.text: Lyennualora is a hunter's sigil-thread woven through the minds of Miimeth's mage-trackers, binding a single chosen prey to the wielder's gaze until the quarry falls or the hour runs out. Its marked targets bleed a faint silver scent that allies can follow across any terrain. Each deeper invocation lets a companion lend its strike to the hunt.

rites.name: Elennalys
rites.text: Elennalys is the lattice-guardian of the Thrennmoor Reach, a sentient aurora that binds wandering stars into orbit around the sleeping world of Miimeth. Her arcane sigils mend the fractures left by ancient cataclysms, and she can unravel a dying sun's magnetic fury when the balance falters.

rites.name: Silannys
rites.text: Silannys is a veil-technique of the Miimeth arcane schools, taught in the sixth age to wardens who sought to vanish between the flicker of one heartbeat and the next. Its practitioners could slip across a field of war faster than any eye could track, then dissolve into the shadows of a broken hillside. The art is considered a concept more than a weapon, and its feats are recorded in fragments.

rites.name: Ilyamora
rites.text: Ilyamora is a sealed concept of quiet skill in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, an artifact-scholar's discipline that sharpens a practitioner's trained competence. Its foundations were laid in the seventh age, when the first masters learned to lean their chosen abilities into perfect focus.

rites.name: Ryeriel
rites.text: Ryeriel is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a stubborn endurance woven from seven ages of weathering the cruel currents of the Veil of Ash. Those who reach its hardened tier can shrug off blows that would split lesser souls, their resolve tempered like fired clay.

rites.name: Lyarla
rites.text: Lyarla is a lantern-keeper of the Miimeth arcane orders, a concept rather than a being, whose quiet glow steadies anyone who walks within its reach. Her light lets companions shake off a bad roll on tasks of tracking, healing, watching, slipping unseen, and foraging, though only a handful of times before the glow must rest. Her bearers say she never burns brighter than a candle, yet the calm she spreads has steadied whole armies through the chasms of E6.

rites.name: Oriimys
rites.text: Oriimys is a concept-realm hunting doctrine in Miimeth's Arcane era, where a hunter binds a chosen quarry to their own fate before the first clash. The marked prey falters under the hunter's gaze, and the hunter shrugs off the traps that the quarry would otherwise set.

rites.name: Veninerora
rites.text: Veninerora is the sixth-era discipline of the Miimeth arcane schools, a practice that lets a duelist strike again in the same breath once a certain threshold of training is reached. Its adepts describe the second blow as arriving from the same heartbeat rather than the next, which is why scholars treat it as a concept rather than a spell.

rites.name: Silenae
rites.text: The Shardblight is a relic forged from the heart of a collapsed star, granting its bearer the power to strike foes with a single, devastating blow that can cripple or terrify them. Each use consumes a fragment of the shard’s energy, leaving the wielder weakened until the next rest. The artifact’s influence wanes as the star’s remnants cool, but its legacy endures in legends of fallen heroes.

rites.name: Sileminna
rites.text: Sileminna is a tidal concept in the arcane realm of Miimeth, a brine-thread that rises from any sea-salt within reach to smother fire and chill flesh. It seals burning things against kindling for a short span, and its cold bites deeper with each age of the practitioner.

rites.name: Nueniomora
rites.text: Nueniomora is a concept of stone-summoning craft from the Arcane realm of Miimeth, where a caster calls a small boulder that streaks to a chosen mark and bursts on arrival. Its bursts rattle nearby bodies, growing stronger as the caster's skill deepens across the age of the Stone Choirs.

rites.name: Silarae
rites.text: Silarae is a scrying art in which Miimeth's casters lend their sight to the last living thing they brushed against. Its mechanics are bounded by a ward of skin and recency, and the watched creature always senses the gaze upon its own eyes.

rites.name: Ilyarae
rites.text: Ilyarae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a sculptor-spirit whose one hand turns to weathered basalt on command. Its blows crack wards and shatter the stone-walled fortresses of the Third Age, and it is said to be the first pact that a hermit learned to keep with the mountains.

rites.name: Nuerys
rites.text: Nuerys is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a binding that turns a leap into an instant crossing to the point where the leap would land. Any creature of modest size caught in that path is knocked flat and may be seized by the traveler's free hand.

rites.name: Nuimys
rites.text: Nuimys is a silver tide of quiet that a wielder spreads over companions, letting them move through heavy mail as freely as bare skin and carry burdens that would bow a mule. Each additional layer of the spell's craft gathers another soul under the same hush, so a skilled caster can lighten an entire vanguard at once.

rites.name: Veneima
rites.text: Veneima is a silent mental echo, a sigil of resentment worn like a bruise, that the Miimeth arcane orders cultivate among their cloistered duelists. When an ally is wounded, the echo lashes back into the assailant's mind, and the more ornate the casting, the deeper the psychic wound it carves. The ally's own wounds knit slightly in sympathy with the backlash.

rites.name: Miinna
rites.text: Miinna is a sealed rhythm of ember-threaded tides that a Miimeth weaver draws across a single breath, lending the hovering motes of a sleeping sea for one heartbeat. Its heart is a chorus of four quiet voices that answer any mind, then fade back into the depths before the listening stops.

rites.name: Elaenae
rites.text: Elaenae is a concept of Arcane craft in the Miimeth universe, a ward that draws loose projectiles toward a chosen bearer and sends wayward shots astray from anyone near it. Its practitioners weave it into banners, statues, and herds so that arrows and stones seek the marked thing rather than the people beside it.

rites.name: Nuillys
rites.text: Nuillys is a concept of arcane exchange in Miimeth, an era-six power that trades the places of two willing or unwilling beings of similar build within sight. Its strength lies in relocation, not destruction, so its authors kept it modest and scaled it only with added exchanges. Practitioners treat it as a courtesy-bound art that fails whenever either party resists.

rites.name: Nuenualla
rites.text: Nuenualla is a veil-form woven from the dark between lantern-light, letting a willing wearer fold themselves and their belongings into a silent, clinging silhouette. Its strength is in evasion and passage rather than force, slipping through cracks and past guards while its bearer cannot speak, reach, or strike. The form dissolves when its bearer falls, leaving them unharmed by ordinary blows.

rites.name: Ilyerlae
rites.text: Ilyerlae is an arcane sensing construct woven into the Miimeth omniverse, a hovering lens of silver light that drifts above its bearer's crown and reveals the world from every angle at once. Scholars of the E6 era treat it as a humble but precious working, valued for granting sight that cannot be ambushed or blinded by surprise. Its light is faint and its reach is measured in sightlines rather than force.

rites.name: Veniorla
rites.text: Veniorla is a reactive warding concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a spell-form that bends the threads of fate around a visible creature the instant harm is aimed at them. The blow passes through without touching them, but its full weight is stored and returned to them as a delayed backlash once the warding fades. Practitioners of the Third Age treat it as both shield and debt.

rites.name: Ryenamwen
rites.text: Ryenamwen is a radiant glimmer-bloom of the Arcane realm that bursts into a shimmering cloud when startled, leaving sparkling motes on everything nearby. Creatures dusted with its pollen shine like lanterns and cannot hide in shadow. Its brilliant flare can overwhelm the sight of those who look upon it.

rites.name: Silaelwen
rites.text: Silaelwen is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a sliver of hushed shadow that its practitioners slip into between heartbeats. Those who have stepped through it describe the moment as a held breath that the world cannot see, and a blow delivered from it arrives with a shriek of silent force.

rites.name: Ilyemeth
rites.text: Ilyemeth is a rite-binding of the Miimeth cosmos that restores any shifted form to its first, true shape across a sphere of influence. Its tether is said to pull every altered soul back toward the self it was born as.

rites.name: Elerae
rites.text: Elerae is a shadow-walking technique practiced in the dim hollows of Miimeth, where a practitioner slips from one pool of gloom into another with a flicker of displaced air. It grants a brief, twice-repeatable step through the dark that cannot be used in open daylight. Its power is subtle, mostly bounded by the reach of unlit corners.

rites.name: Oriirys
rites.text: Oriirys is a concept of heightened reflex woven into the Arcane powers of Miimeth during the sixth era, granted by a caster to themselves and up to six nearby allies. Those touched dodge harm with uncanny grace, often escaping blasts entirely and sustaining only a fraction of what would otherwise wound them.

rites.name: Venalluama
rites.text: Venalluama is an arcane scholar-sorcerer of Miimeth who keeps a ledger of every spell she has ever bent to her will. Her patron is said to be a sleeping star-engine that grants her borrowed power in exchange for her unfinished proofs. When she casts in earnest, the ink on her ledger writes the shape of the blast before it lands.

rites.name: Venillama
rites.text: Venillama is a silver-threaded lattice of cold moonlight woven between the ribs of Miimeth's sunken observatories, where scholars learn to borrow the mind's own geometry to amplify a patron's gifts. Its measures are kept by the Tallow Cartographers, who note each new sigil a student may bind only after it is confirmed by the patron's sanctioned index. Those who wield it reason their way into power rather than feeling it, letting logic stand where charisma once stood.

rites.name: Alaereth
rites.text: Alaereth is a concept of a bargained binding, in which a patron's fragments are etched into a chosen mind so that small, lasting powers can be borrowed and later exchanged. Its three forms of reckoning are measured by what the bearer can endure and what a single act can release, and by the speed at which its influence travels across the dim realms of Miimeth.

rites.name: Nuamys
rites.text: Nuamys is a whispered curse-craft of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, where a speaker murmurs a single unwelcome truth that clings to one chosen foe and gnaws at their strength. The binding lasts only while the speaker keeps it, and it breaks the moment a cleansing rite touches the victim.

rites.name: Miallaemeth
rites.text: Miallaemeth is a dormant concept of sealed arcane knowledge, a sovereign cipher bestowed in layered gifts that unlock across an era of ascending power. Its single sanctioned rite may be performed once without drawing on ordinary reserves, and the seal renews only after a full season of rest.

rites.name: Lyaneth
rites.text: Lyaneth is a warlock-patron cult-arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, where a bound patron grants its servant a single hidden reservoir of borrowed power. Once the reservoir is drawn, the caster must wait out a full rest before it refills, keeping its use rare and dangerous.

rites.name: Elinae
rites.text: Elinae is a concept of focused sorcery in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, an echo of a student's mind that sharpens every spark cast at the height of their training. Those who learn to channel it find that a modest cantrip gains a sharp, reasoned edge drawn from their own cleverness.

rites.name: Lyiluannys
rites.text: Lyiluannys is a resonance-craft in Miimeth's arcane era E6, in which a practitioner who has mastered the art may, after weaving one minor working, lace a second minor working into the same breath of power. The technique is considered a quiet mark of accomplishment rather than a spectacle, and few masters ever teach it openly.

rites.name: Venaneiliel
rites.text: Venaneiliel is the concept of a hidden storehouse folded beyond the ordinary sky of Miimeth, where a bonded wielder's arms are kept when not in use. Its weapons slip into that pocket on a whim and return to the feet of their bearer when called or when the bond finally fails.

rites.name: Silenys
rites.text: Silenys is a dormant sentient resonance woven into the bone-lattice of the Miimeth deeps, awakening only when a bonded wielder draws breath in its presence. Its gift is a doubled cadence: each commanded strike rings twice through the wielder's arm, the second echo carrying nearly as much force as the first.

rites.name: Ryiriolwen
rites.text: Ryiriolwen is a cursed resonance that coils through a warlock's chosen blade, siphoning the wielder's keen mind into a grave-cold bite that lingers in the wound. Once a foe is marked by its whispering hex, the blade seeks out the weak points of that victim with uncanny precision.

rites.name: Venuareth
rites.text: Venuareth is a ritual of binding that a warlock's oath-blade cannot refuse, a mode of striking in which the wound opens a door through which a second craft may pour. Those who master it speak of the blow as a key, and of the hidden lock in every living thing that answers to it.

rites.name: Alaelys
rites.text: Alaelys is a quiet resonance woven into the ember-threads of the Miimeth courts, granting a bearer a faint tremor of borrowed instinct whenever they reach for an unfamiliar craft. Scholars of the E6 era recorded its pulse as a shimmer in the air that steadied hesitant hands. It is less a weapon than a tutor that whispers when the bearer has never learned the trick.

rites.name: Venerilwen
rites.text: Venerilwen is a cold, silver-veined sigil-engine of the Arcane realm's sixth era, born from a broken oath between mind-wardens. It answers any blow aimed at its bearer by lashing the striker's thoughts and hurling them backward through the air.

rites.name: Alaimys
rites.text: Alaimys is a quiet ward-signet of the Miimeth arcane orders, carved from cooled starglass and worn by those who study the hidden seams between spells. Its bearers gain a faint steadiness when resisting forces they were never trained against, a small tremor of fortune that settles their nerve. Scholars regard it as a modest artifact whose real worth lies in the stubbornness it teaches.

rites.name: Siluanys
rites.text: Siluanys is a ritual sigil-bond that lets its keeper and an idol-wearer slip through the weave of space to stand beside one another, so long as both remain bound to the same layer of reality. Its quiet power grows with the practitioner's mastery and is channelled through a sacred mask.

rites.name: Ryamaerleth
rites.text: Ryamaerleth is a discipline of woven vestment-sigils that let a practitioner turn studied thought into a living ward, provided the body is left bare of plate and shield. Its adepts are reckoned by how clearly they can hold a single pattern steady while moving through a storm of blades. Few gain its full strength before the third turning of their apprenticeship.

rites.name: Elinora
rites.text: Elinora is a concept-born arcane current in the Miimeth omniverse, a presence that formed three ages ago where the powers of the Arcane realm first learned to fold back on themselves. She answers a missed blow with a reflexive spark of sorcery aimed at the one who swung, and her bearing makes pursuers stumble as though the ground itself resists them.

rites.name: Oriinae
rites.text: Oriinae is a hexing discipline in Miimeth's arcane tradition, where a practitioner binds a rival's fate to their own so that every blow aimed at the caster rebounds as withering rot. At its height the caster's will becomes a shield that absorbs what the cursed foe inflicts.

rites.name: Ryennimiel
rites.text: Ryennimiel is a mnemonic discipline in the Miimeth arcane tradition, teaching that a practitioner who guards the self can slip a minor working through the gap of a defensive stance. Its adepts are said to weave their smallest spells in the instant between a parry and a breath, so the ward and the wonder share one motion.

rites.name: Silanniel
rites.text: Silanniel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a bodily pact in which a patron's gift grows living blades from the flesh of its bearer. The concept is said to have been forged in the seventh age of the sixth era, and its manifested extensions can be drawn in or unfurled at will.

rites.name: Mienwen
rites.text: Mienwen is a quiet lattice of resonance-bells strung between the drifting islands of the Miimeth sky, a concept rather than a being. Those who learn its rhythm can pair a sudden strike with a brief burst of forward momentum in the same moment. Its tones, once rung, carry a faint echo of stellar kindling.

rites.name: Lyelae
rites.text: Lyelae is a concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a discipline of the Arcane realm from the sixth era, now three ages old. It names the practice by which a body's own claws, fangs, or horns are woven with sigils until each strike carries sorcerous weight, and the practitioner may strike twice in the span of a single committed assault.

rites.name: Lyina
rites.text: Lyina is an arcane mode of hexcraft practised in the Miimeth powers, where a binder's curse feeds back a portion of the vitality it drains. Adepts who master its final rite can turn their own bodily strikes into resonant blows of a chosen element.

rites.name: Eleinna
rites.text: Eleinna is a thread of silver resonance woven through the arcane currents of Miimeth, a presence that answers the moment a caster commits their will to a working. Those who bind to it learn to strike again in the same breath as their incantation, their claws and fists humming with leftover sorcery.

rites.name: Mienamora
rites.text: Mienamora is a concept of enchanted resonance, a melody that can unmake walls and wills alike in the Miimeth omniverse during its seventh age. Its power is channeled through instruments of dread that turn song into fear and devotion. Those who master its voice can coax the stars themselves into dancing out of rhythm.

rites.name: Venioneth
rites.text: Venioneth is a quiet resonance woven into the old wardstones of Miimeth, a lattice that lets a single whispered incantation ripple outward to a second listener nearby. Its bearers learned it as a minor refinement of hand-crafted spell tricks, sharing a spark between targets within a short reach. The Arcane realm records it as a concept of modest, precise magnitude.

rites.name: Venaelae
rites.text: Venaelae is a concept of hexing resonance in the arcane realm of Miimeth, where a binding curse makes a victim's will ring like a struck bell. Once a hex has taken hold at the highest mastery, the affected mind cannot resist a gentle shove, unless it carries a rare reserve of defiance. Any concussive chord sung into such a hexed target also detonates within it as a thunderclap scaled to the caster's mental acuity.

rites.name: Venama
rites.text: Venama is the quiet art of threading a hush through a caster's ordinary spells, letting a single breath of focus strike three separate minds at once. Practitioners of the Miimeth arcane schools describe it as a second voice that speaks beneath the first, each word aimed at a different heart. It is the signature of the old hush-weavers of the Ashen Reach.

rites.name: Eluanae
rites.text: Eluanae is a concept of ember-woven sorcery in the Miimeth omniverse, a discipline that channels a pact with an unnamed infernal patron into controlled blazes of rising power. Its practitioners unlock the flame in stages, from a palm-sized burst to walls of fire that can scorch a city block.

rites.name: Venella
rites.text: Venella is an arcane discipline in Miimeth, a sheathing of wild ember that wakes in a practitioner's spells and blows, letting a single extra scorching pulse follow any strike that already landed. Its adepts are prized as ember-wardens in the cold northern holds, where their flare is used to thaw frozen passes.

rites.name: Ilyirla
rites.text: Ilyirla is a concept of a quiet tide that pools in the Arcane realm of Miimeth during the sixth epoch, when minds bend the threads of chance toward their own ends. Those who draw upon it may nudge a falling die or a failing breath by a single unseen measure, but the gift refreshes only after a full rest of the body and spirit.

rites.name: Venaeramora
rites.text: Venaeramora is a veil-spun cloak-current of the Miimeth arcane tides, said to be woven from the breath of drowned choirs. Each dawn after rest it takes the shape of one elemental hue and turns aside every harm of that kind, though blades bearing sigil-iron or star-silver slip through its weave.

rites.name: Veniolys
rites.text: Veniolys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a sealing technique that flings a struck foe into a restless underlayer of dread before it snaps back to its original place. Practitioners may invoke it only once between periods of full rest, as the mind of the hurled foe bears the lasting trauma. Its power is measured not in ruin but in the peril of the trip itself.

rites.name: Oriarys
rites.text: Oriarys is a dread-glamour that drifts through the courts of Miimeth, a fear-scent that unmakes resolve in those who breathe it. Its wielders learn to exhale a shimmering pall that charms the bold or sends the timid fleeing for a single turn before it must rest and gather itself again.

rites.name: Elaenarla
rites.text: Elaenarla is a concept-class arcane entity of the Miimeth omniverse, a being of drifting fog who slips away at the moment of injury. When struck, Elaenarla dissolves into a veil of mist, reappears within a short distance, and stays hidden until it acts again or the cycle resets with rest.

rites.name: Eluarora
rites.text: Eluarora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, an aura of reflected will that turns hostile enchantments back upon their casters. Those who try to bend its mind find their own intent mirrored and their own wills made puppets for a time.

rites.name: Elaelineth
rites.text: Elaelineth is a veiled sovereign of Miimeth's arcane realm, who can draw any gaze into a private mist where only the watcher, the veiled one, and a shifting phantasm exist. The mist lasts until its captive is struck or the weaving unravels, and it can be woven again only after a long pause of stillness.

rites.name: Nuimys
rites.text: Nuimys is a concept of celestial fire held in the hands of Arcane practitioners of the E6 era, who keep a rationed store of luminous dice to mend the wounded within sight. Its keepers are said to be aged two epochs, and each mending draws from a pool refilled only after a full rest. The art is considered gentle, yet its reserves can scorch a sentinel's ward when channelled in anger.

rites.name: Silarla
rites.text: Silarla is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a gift of borrowed grace that a sworn attendant may lend to nearby companions at the moment fate hangs in the balance. Its bearers are said to shine faintly when they steady a comrade's hand or mind. The gift is sparing, returning only after a full rest of the body.

rites.name: Lyela
rites.text: Lyela is a concept of arcane ward-song woven through the Miimeth omniverse, a resonance that gathers around anyone who completes a period of stillness. In the E6 age its echoes steady the bearers of old pacts, lending them a shell of borrowed endurance that spreads to those standing nearest. Its power is modest against cosmic scale but enduring in its quiet, protective way.

rites.name: Elimwen
rites.text: Elimwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth's E6 era, a radiant-channeling sorcerer-saint who refuses to fall. When death looms, she flares into a burst of light that restores her strength and blinds those who stand near her.

rites.name: Ilyannys
rites.text: Ilyannys is a hollow Arcane sigil that drinks the last breath of each fallen foe and returns a fraction of it as stolen vitality to its bearer. Its keepers say the sigil grows stronger with every life it claims, and ancient wardens of Miimeth sealed its shards into the bones of old towers.

rites.name: Sileimwen
rites.text: Sileimwen is a concept of arcane discipline born in the Miimeth omniverse's sixth epoch, a ritual binding that lets a caster draw on the hunger of the abyss whenever a spell is spent. Those who wear its mark are wreathed in black tendrils that seize anything drawn too near to their body.

rites.name: Oriaruamae
rites.text: Oriaruamae is a veil of shadow that the Miimeth scholars of the Sixth Epoch learned to weave into their oaths, a darkness that gazes back through its own folds like a watchful animal. Those bound to it treat their conjured dimness as daylight, reading script and faces inside the gloom as easily as at noon. Its apprentices also speak the first word of the gloom, a humble spell that drapes a small room in sable.

rites.name: Ryirys
rites.text: Ryirys is a dread-bearing herald of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, whose mere nearness drains the will from those who would oppose it. Once it fixes its gaze on a foe, that foe is pinned in place, struck blind and deaf, and sinks into terror if it stands in shadow. The hold lasts until the victim wills itself free or the herald rests.

rites.name: Nuarlilae
rites.text: Nuarlilae is a veil-weaver of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a concept of shadow-bound patronage that cloaks its bearer whenever dusk or dark settles around them. Its shroud lasts a single slow minute, and the cloak can be drawn only twice before the bearer must rest and let the veil reknit itself.

rites.name: Nuimeth
rites.text: Nuimeth is a shadow-form concept from the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a being who can dissolve into a vast, unlit gloom for a single minute. Within that gloom, darkness belongs only to the creatures it chooses, and the self can strike from any point of the dusk before dissolving again.

rites.name: Venarleth
rites.text: Venarleth is a concept of a bargain-kept mind that rewrites its own store of learned workings each time the sleeper wakes, trading one set of rote incantations for another within the limits of the powers it has earned. It also carries a small household sleight that conjures harmless sparks, warm breath, and tidy stains across the chambers of Miimeth's third age. Its refreshes are quiet, but its reach is strictly bounded by the reservoir of its own sanctioned might.

rites.name: Lyireth
rites.text: Lyireth is a teleportation technique practiced by weavers of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, who learn to tear through the threads of space and reappear within a short distance. Upon arrival, a shockwave of arcane force bursts outward, lifting smaller foes into the air where they hang motionless until the caster's next turn.

rites.name: Silanerae
rites.text: Silanerae is the quiet state a caster reaches when their spellwork has woven itself into their own body and breath, so that the arcane forces they command no longer strike them as foreign. Those who attain it can shrug off much of the harm that their own kind of magic would inflict, and rival enchantments cannot easily tear their focus from a working once begun.

rites.name: Alaelys
rites.text: Alaelys is a concept of a lattice-sustained mind in the Miimeth omniverse, a patient witness that holds two threads of arcane will at once and lets one fall only when the lattice demands it. Its tolerance is bounded, so a strain beyond its limit unravels both threads together, and rest is required before it can hold again.

rites.name: Siluamena
rites.text: Siluamena is a mind-weaving concept from the Arcane realm of Miimeth's sixth era, a faculty that lets its bearers speak directly into the thoughts of any living being in sight within thirty paces. Its speech needs no shared tongue, only that the listener grasp some language at all, so it bridges even the most alien of minds.

rites.name: Elama
rites.text: Elama is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, an impulse of unreadable visions that a mind-seer projects back into any aggressor who strikes them. Its effect breaks the attacker's composure for a while, and it can only be drawn again after rest.

rites.name: Ilyareth
rites.text: Ilyareth is a mental discipline in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, where the practitioner's inner mind grows so vast and strange that intruders cannot parse it or find its truths. Once per rest, the Ilyareth may open that mind outward and perceive hidden forms within sixty feet for ten minutes.

rites.name: Eluarae
rites.text: Eluarae is a concept-born arcane intelligence in the Miimeth omniverse, an entity that exists as a lattice of unfinished thoughts spanning an entire age. It can slip a whispering bloom of its own mind into a stunned mortal, binding their loyalty until a purifying rite or its own withdrawal frees them.

rites.name: Nuamwen
rites.text: Nuamwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a patron-spirit of tempered wyrm-light that lingers in the third age of the sixth era. It lends its bearers a tongue of old scale-speech and a will that no dread-roar can shake.

rites.name: Elamionneth
rites.text: Elamionneth is the quiet tide of a corroding mind, a concept in the Miimeth omniverse that dissolves the boundaries of whatever it touches over long ages. In the arcane era E6 it is said to have first taught the stones of the lower spires how to forget their shapes. Its power is measured less in blasts than in patient, unstoppable undoing.

rites.name: Venameilwen
rites.text: Venameilwen is a lightning-threaded oath-craft of the Miimeth Arcane realm, taught through sworn bargains with sky-bound wardens whose blue scales crackle with stored storms. Its practitioners learn to channel the charge of the upper air into arcs that can split stone and hush distant thunder.

rites.name: Siluaneth
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Lumina, the entity known as Siluaneth embodies the corrupting influence of decay, spreading rot and ruin with its touch.

rites.name: Lyanwen
rites.text: Lyanwen is a sigil-bound pact-binding in the Miimeth arcane tradition, drawing its heat from an ember-hearted sovereign who lends a sliver of inner furnace to those who sign. Practitioners channel this borrowed flame through wards and bodies, though the pact is said to burn slowly through anyone who reaches too far.

rites.name: Veniomwen
rites.text: Veniomwen is a frost-bound sorcerer-concept of the Miimeth omniverse, drawing thaw and freezing from an ancient pale wyrm that taught the first wardens the arts of stillness. Its arcane spells can lock rivers, bind wounds in ice, and hush the motion of whatever it touches.

rites.name: Silarlionae
rites.text: Silarlionae is a sigil-bound pact of arcane sovereignty in the Miimeth omniverse, a kindling bond that lets a practitioner draw sparks from the ember-hearts of distant suns. Its wielders are said to hold a flicker of ancient furnace-song that flares when the pact is tested.

rites.name: Lyerluarys
rites.text: Lyerluarys is a storm-bound oath-power in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, drawn from a sky-warden's bargain that lets its wielder gather and loose crackling current. Its discharges have been known to split stone and ignite the air itself during the third age of the era.

rites.name: Lyelana
rites.text: Lyelana is a concept of arcane pact-craft in the Miimeth omniverse, a binding that draws a sharpened corrosive bite from an old patron's hoard of verdigris-touched sorrow. In the sixth epoch she is two years into her bargain, and her spellwork already dissolves iron and stone wherever her hand lingers.

rites.name: Ryeriel
rites.text: Ryeriel is a bound ember-caller of the Miimeth arcane orders, a channel of sun-warm flame drawn through a pact with a distant sovereign of molten light. In the sixth era, Ryeriel's kindled sigils can sear through the iron-bound gates of the Hollow Vaults.

rites.name: Nuelluaneth
rites.text: Nuelluaneth is a frost-current of the Miimeth arcane weave, a seam of chilled starlight that sings where the old Silver-touched sorceries freeze the air into glass. Her working is less a body than a pattern the weave keeps returning to, cold as a pressed hymn.

rites.name: Lyirlora
rites.text: Lyirlora is a dormant resonance-thread woven through the Arcane realm of Miimeth, said to answer only those who have wept for the stars. Practitioners who bind to it find their chosen elemental affinity sharpened, allowing them to coax a second, more favorable pattern from their own ruinous working. The thread is older than the current era and remembers every failed attempt.

rites.name: Elinae
rites.text: Elinae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, an ancient ward-binding that lets a bearer's will reshape a failed stroke of fate into a second, unwilling chance. Its carriers slowly acquire scale-like sheathing that turns aside one kind of elemental harm. The binding can be drawn only once before the bearer must rest for an age-long span.

rites.name: Siluarirla
rites.text: Siluarirla is a dread-song that a warlock of Miimeth can loose once between rests, a roar that rolls through the air and grips the minds of every creature within a hundred and twenty feet. Those who hear it must steady their own hearts against the echo of an ancient, hungry patron, or be left trembling for a minute. The horror lingers only as long as the listener keeps failing to shake it off.

rites.name: Alairlora
rites.text: Alairlora is a hunter-spirit of the Miimeth arcane reaches who never runs out of quarry, for each mark she claims another rises in its place. When a marked soul dies beneath her curse, she can pass the binding to a fresh target within ninety feet, and every bound creature moves a little slower under her gaze.

rites.name: Venimwen
rites.text: Venimwen is a concept of Miimeth's Arcane realm in the E6 era, a veil of hoarfrost that drifts with a chosen walker and cloaks their approach in blinding white. Within its margin, open fire gutters out and the unshielded feel their breath freeze. It may be woven again only after its wielder has known a full rest.

rites.name: Venaneileth
rites.text: Venaneileth is a frost-attuned discipline in the arcane tradition of Miimeth, whose practitioners are hardened by glacial cold until their flesh shrugs off the chill. Its adepts can briefly wrap themselves in a shell of rime that turns aside ordinary blows for a single turn after they unleash a frozen working.

rites.name: Silerlireth
rites.text: Silerlireth is a concept of Arcane power in the world of Miimeth, a hunter's grip on a marked prey that refuses to let its bearer fall. Those who carry it stay awake through their wounds, and their death is held back until the mark they keep is broken.

rites.name: Alainarlys
rites.text: Alainarlys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a quiet aura woven from the hushed, half-solid memories of a vanished choir. Where it settles, the dying find a stubborn grip on life and the ground grows thick and clinging for foes the aura has chosen.

rites.name: Venaelwen
rites.text: Venaelwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, a rite of the Hollow Choir in which the restless departed are summoned to wrap the caster in a ring of frost. Those who linger inside the ring are seized by the chill of unrest and flung outward, unable to return until the caster's next turn.

rites.name: Ryeniollora
rites.text: Ryeniollora is a sealed aura-discipline that a warden grows through steady practice, its radiance hardening allied bodies against grave cold and withering decay. Those who stand within its glow may shield one another from the same chill and rot, and arrows loosed from beyond its edge find their marks softened as if behind a stone wall.

rites.name: Oriilleth
rites.text: Oriilleth is a rallying sigil-choir of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a chant-bound legion of spectral wardens who step forth at the summoner's call to shield their chosen allies. For one fleeting minute their presence wraps up to six comrades in a borrowed vitality that also draws the fallen back from the edge of death.

rites.name: Elinarys
rites.text: Elinarys is a concept of a shimmering luminous veil that the Miimeth arcane orders use as a personal ward, weaving brilliant light into a spinning shell about a bearer. Any foe lingering too near the veil at the end of a turn is scorched by a burst of radiance, and the veil cannot be woven again until the bearer rests.

rites.name: Alairuanwen
rites.text: Alairuanwen is a concept of refuge-craft in the Miimeth omniverse, a stillness the Arcane realm grants to those who learn to fold themselves briefly outside ordinary time. Practitioners vanish for a single turn into a quiet pocket of unmoving light, where they may gather their strength before stepping back into the flow of events.

rites.name: Venariel
rites.text: Venariel is a sealed concept of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a discipline of inner stillness in which the practitioner's lungs fall quiet and heat and frost slide off their skin like rain. Its masters in the E6 age used it to walk the furnace vents of dead suns and the frozen cores of comets without harm.

rites.name: Lyimuanae
rites.text: Lyimuanae is a sigil that lets a caster and a handful of allies slip into a pocket of the Void for brief, restorative pauses. By chanting the sigil’s syllables, the group is carried into the shimmering plane where time stalls, allowing them to recover as if they had rested uninterrupted. When the ritual ends, they reappear in the same spots they left, unchanged by the world’s passing.

rites.name: Ilyerys
rites.text: Ilyerys is a quiet discipline of the Miimeth arcane orders, taught to scholars who wish to slip a single breath ahead of rivals in the seventh age of the Sixth Era. Adepts who master it are said to read the chronicles of their own futures, granting them a sharp edge in reckoning who acts first.

rites.name: Ilyinelwen
rites.text: Ilyinelwen is a concept of tidal foresight, a quiet power that lets a mind nudge the order in which events unfold for chosen minds. Its bearers are said to have once rearranged the moment a fleet was to strike, though the record of that battle is itself disputed. Each bearer must rest fully before the power stirs again.

rites.name: Sileraerla
rites.text: Sileraerla is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a presence that can nudge the flow of moments around a combatant who is under threat. Its influence is subtle, mostly bending the instant of a blow so that it lands awkwardly, and it rests after each use. Those who study it say its true nature is unreadable, since even the most careful observers cannot judge its sincerity.

rites.name: Miinys
rites.text: Miinys is a concept in Miimeth's arcane realm: a resonant tremor drawn from a distant patron's echo, shaped into a binding voice that can shake the air over a small crowd. Its roar carries across open ground for hundreds of feet, leaving anyone who hears it dazed and staggered.

rites.name: Venileiniel
rites.text: Venileiniel is a silent warden of the Miimeth reaches, a being whose hunger was burned away when it bargained with the grey lantern-moons. Its touch carries a faint rot that unravels whatever it strikes, and it sustains itself on the slow decay of the air around it.

rites.name: Eluanniorae
rites.text: Eluanniorae is a dread-tinged manifestation a Miimeth warlock can briefly wear, in which a borrowed fragment of an unseen patron's terror wraps the bearer in ash-gray armor. Each awakening lends a surge of resilience and makes foes flinch from each blow landed. It can be called forth only a limited number of times before rest restores the bearer's strength.

rites.name: Veninora
rites.text: Veninora is a grave-tide sorcery within the Miimeth omniverse, a discipline that lets a practitioner hold the cold hunger of the dead inside their own flesh. Adepts who reach its highest rank become nearly impervious to rot and venom and age only a tenth as fast as the world around them. Its arts are prized by long-lived scholars and feared by those who fear the slow erosion of time.

rites.name: Oriilwen
rites.text: Oriilwen is a concept of quiet restoration in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, an ability that knits the bodies of those who have learned its patient discipline. Practitioners slowly mend their own flesh each dawn of their working hours, and a severed limb will rejoin its owner if set back in place with conviction. The Veil-scholars of the seventh age regard it as a faint echo of older mysteries of endurance.

rites.name: Lyineirla
rites.text: Lyineirla is a drowsing lattice of dream-threads in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a concept that keeps its bearers awake through any ritual or spell. Its wakefulness is not a burden but a discipline, since rest is earned only through quiet tasks like tending a lantern or turning pages. Scholars of the sixth era consider it the most stubborn of the old sleep-binders.

rites.name: Lyinae
rites.text: Lyinae is the ember-sigil of the Miimeth arcane school, a concept of sparks that remember the hand that kindled them. When a caster weaves a pact-fire into a spell, the sigil hums and sharpens the next clear moment of their judgment before the turn ends.

rites.name: Elaruannora
rites.text: Elaruannora is a silver-threaded weave of listening-magic in the Miimeth omniverse, a concept that lets any hearer converse with the wild creatures of the Arcane realm without cost. Its tellers hold that it binds no spell, only a shared breath between mind and beast.

rites.name: Venalys
rites.text: Venalys is a veiled bargain-craft of the Miimeth Arcane, a lattice of borrowed voices that lets a speaker wear the very certainty of others. Its keepers say it is less a power than a loan, repaid in the trust that cracks when the mask slips. Few in the seventh age of the realm ever learn to name its price.

rites.name: Silarlora
rites.text: Silarlora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a quiet technique of pulling or pushing a struck foe a few paces through the crude tug of focused will. It belongs to the early era, where mages learned to bend small distances before they learned to bend the stars.

rites.name: Alaanuamwen
rites.text: Alaanuamwen is a quiet sensory grace in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a faculty of the eye that pierces both shadow and spellcraft alike, reaching a clear span of roughly thirty-six meters. Its bearers use it to read the unseen threads of enchantment woven through dark vaults and forgotten groves. It is a gift of perception rather than force, though its keenest use can unravel a ward at close range.

rites.name: Eleiminnora
rites.text: Eleiminnora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, an attunement that lets a speaker's words take root in any mind able to parse meaning, however alien its tongue. Its bearers are sought by envoys who need no interpreter and feared by those who would rather keep their secrets private.

rites.name: Sileinaelys
rites.text: Sileinaelys is a silver-threaded tuning principle in the Miimeth omniverse, a way of listening for the hum that all enchanted things give off. Scholars of the sixth era use it to sense latent enchantment at will, drawing on no reserve of stored craft to do so. Its reach is quiet and its own cost is nearly nothing.

rites.name: Alaarlae
rites.text: Alaarlae is a Miimeth concept of the Arcane realm, a stitched-thread rite that a practitioner can hold over their own pulse at any hour, drawing a thin ward of borrowed vitality without drawing down any reserve of the mind. It leaves no residue of ash or salt, and the ward gutters out quietly when the wearer's will lets it go.

rites.name: Oriillioma
rites.text: Oriillioma is a silent sensory ritual binding the ruler of the Eshkari sky-cloisters to a chosen attendant, so that the sovereign sees through the attendant's eyes and hears through their ears. The connection lasts only as long as both stand under the same heavens and is renewed each turn by a shared breath. Its power lies entirely in perception, never in force.

rites.name: Ryinnae
rites.text: Ryinnae is a sustaining resonance of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a silver hum that stitches wounds shut whenever a healing rite is spoken over a living body. Its gift lets every restorative dice roll land on its full face, so a healer's modest spell becomes a near-perfect mending.

rites.name: Miirlae
rites.text: Miirlae is a concept of thinning-sigil lore in the Miimeth omniverse, a practice of drawing binding lines through ordinary air until the world itself resists movement. Its practitioners learned to press a single silent sigil that holds every nearby foe in place, though it can only be drawn once before the bearer must rest. The concept is said to echo the old tradition of tethering rivers with stone.

rites.name: Miirae
rites.text: Miirae is a quiet ember-thread woven through the bones of Miimeth's oldest stone, a concept of mending that lets a bearer restore flesh twice over before the lamp of their own reserve must be lit. It returns with the slow tide of rest, as though the body remembers how to heal itself each dawn.

rites.name: Venerlimiel
rites.text: Venerlimiel is a dormant lattice of silver thread that hums only when a caster's spell breathes through it, binding the pull of the ground around a struck foe. Within the Arcane realm of Miimeth it is a concept rather than a being, a tool for slowing rivals in the closing hours of an era. Its power is small and precise, a faint drag rather than any force of destruction.

rites.name: Ryallae
rites.text: Ryallae is a mirthful sorcerous discipline in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, where practitioners weave gleeful compulsions that send foes into helpless fits of giggling. Its adepts can unleash one such jest without drawing on their pact-bound reserves, a privilege renewed only after a full night's rest. Each jest is a brief, harmless-seeming ripple of joy that nonetheless paralyses the mind of anyone who hears it.

rites.name: Elireimys
rites.text: Elireimys is a veil-weaving principle in the Miimeth omniverse, a concept that lets any wearer slip a borrowed face over their own without cost. Scholars of the E6 era treat it as a cheap trick of perception rather than a true force, and its uses are mostly theatrical and clandestine.

rites.name: Mienniel
rites.text: Mienniel is a quiet, veiled cantrip-theory named for the first mind that bent light into shapes without drawing from any well of power. Scholars of Miimeth regard it as an intimate art, its phantoms costing nothing but attention and never outlasting the breath that conjured them.

rites.name: Miirerliel
rites.text: Miirerliel is a silver-threaded tide of concentrated gravity-song that the Arcane choirs of Miimeth drew from the hum of dying stars. It answers any mage who strikes a foe with a small ranged spell, shoving the target one stride along a straight line away from the caster. The shove is gentle, but it has been known to hurl rivals off cliffs and across battlefields.

rites.name: Elaerora
rites.text: Elaerora is a sleeping pattern of spite woven into the marrow of Miimeth's dreaming leylines, a concept that a mind may borrow once to curse a rival's resolve. Each borrowing is repaid only when the borrower has fully rested, so the curse can never be spent twice in a single waking.

rites.name: Sileniora
rites.text: Sileniora is a quiet bending of motion, a lattice of silver threads that lets anything wrapped in it slip past its own momentum. Within the Miimeth arcane tradition of the sixth era it is treated less as a spell than as a reflex, drawn from the air whenever it is needed. Its practitioners learn to move before danger finishes forming.

rites.name: Lyalora
rites.text: Lyalora is a silver-threaded sigil-weaving discipline in the Miimeth omniverse, practiced by wanderers who bind lift into their own bodies through patient gestures. Its adepts drift above the ruined ferrowheat fields of the E6 age, a skill once reserved for the temple floating-cranes of Olmuth.

rites.name: Mialirwen
rites.text: Mialirwen is a quiet discipline of borrowed will, taught in the drowned archives of Miimeth, where practitioners learn to speak one command into another mind without drawing from their reserves. Its adepts recover the knack only after a full night of stillness, so every use is treated as a debt against the sleeper's own rest.

rites.name: Lyarleth
rites.text: Lyarleth is a dormant ember-thread woven through the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a lattice that once let wanderers summon loyal mounts from the glow between worlds. Its bearers draw on it only once per rest, and each summoning leaves a faint warmth in the air for days afterward.

rites.name: Lyanniel
rites.text: Lyanniel is a concept of a bound oath-flame in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a spark of withering light that a sworn bearer may loose once before the next dawn of rest. While it burns through their limbs, their strikes and their hold on heavy things grow sure and steady.

rites.name: Venamiel
rites.text: Venamiel is a quiet sorrow-spirit of the Miimeth dreaming-deeps, believed to feed on the hesitations of minds that have forgotten their own resolve. Once each rest-cycle it can bend a crowd's thoughts into a tangled fog, though the fog never lasts past the next dawn of its wielder's strength.

rites.name: Lyirae
rites.text: Lyirae is a crystalline shell-ward in the realm of Arcane practice, a reactive glaze that encases a caster in frozen mirror-glass the instant harm lands. The ice drinks in the blow as a buffer of borrowed vitality, but the wearer stays locked, brittle to flame, and rooted until the frost thaws at the close of the next turn.

rites.name: Veniorae
rites.text: Veniorae is a dormant arcane sense that wakes in the cloudy eyes of Miimeth's lamp-keepers, letting them look straight through stone and timber for a brief span. Its power is measured in heartbeats and kept strictly rationed, since each use drains the keeper's reserve until rest restores it.

rites.name: Oriennora
rites.text: Oriennora is a tidal sigil worn as a thin silver scale, granting its bearer the breath of the deep and a swimmer's pace through any current. Its wielder can call the water-breathing rite without spending a stored charge, yet the sigil quiets after one use until the bearer has truly rested.

rites.name: Miannella
rites.text: Miannella is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a psychic resonance that a hexed foe's own dread can be made to sing back through. When a wielder tightens that resonance, the cursed mind shudders and nearby minds that the wielder chooses are jolted with it.

rites.name: Sileiranae
rites.text: Sileiranae is a bone-singing rite practiced by the grave-wardens of Miimeth's drowned coast, letting a caster call the dead to stand twice without drawing on any stored spell. The gift returns fully after a long, undisturbed rest, though the wardens say the dead remember each calling.

rites.name: Silualenys
rites.text: Silualenys is a dormant lattice of bound time-sigils in the Miimeth archive, a concept that lets a reader briefly drag a moving thing toward stillness without spending their reserve. It can be invoked once, then must rest until the next dawn-cycle restores its thread.

rites.name: Venimae
rites.text: Venimae is a veiled shade-weaver of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a concept born in the sixth era and seven ages old. Those who hold the dusk can slip from sight the moment the light thins, and vanish until they stir or act again.

rites.name: Alaerluarae
rites.text: Alaerluarae is a silver-threaded weave of sorcerous will that the people of Miimeth call the Ninth Breath, a thread any trained mind can draw upon at no cost. It lets its wielder spring across distance without a ritual or focus, though the Arcane Concordance has long debated whether such freedom is a gift or a loophole.

rites.name: Oriilae
rites.text: Oriilae is a hexing rite in the Miimeth archive, in which a caster binds a sigil to a foe and may then slip through the air to any open ground near that marked soul while the foe remains in view. Scholars of the Arcane realm treat it as a close-quarters tactic rather than a grand working.

rites.name: Ryenys
rites.text: Ryenys is a sealed lantern-rite in the Miimeth cycle, a single ember that may be kindled once to project a pale lunar lance through any veil. It rekindles only after the lamp-keepers have rested through a full night of the sleeping tides.

rites.name: Oriinnys
rites.text: Oriinnys is a sealed rite of shifting form that a bonded caster may draw once from the silver thread of their pact, after which the thread must rest through a full night of sleep before it will answer again. Those who have worn its change describe the moment as a slow turning of the bones, unlike any ordinary magic woven by hand.

rites.name: Ryamelora
rites.text: Ryamelora is a spell-wielding concept in Miimeth's arcane realm, a whirling storm of blades that can be summoned once and then must rest. Its caster may drag the storm's heart across the battlefield while it holds the working in place.

rites.name: Eluamiel
rites.text: Eluamiel is a minor reflective sigil worn by the wardens of Miimeth's Vaulted Choir, granting its bearer a single unbidden glimpse through distant walls and veils once between rests. The sigil's lattice is quiet, and its power is cheap precisely because it draws almost nothing from the wearer.

rites.name: Elaneth
rites.text: Elaneth is a dormant hex-weaving concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a mnemonic thread that lets a bearer seal a single malediction into the marrow of a foe without drawing upon their reserves of arcane pact-fire. The thread knots itself again only after the bearer has rested through a full night of unbroken sleep.

rites.name: Silinneth
rites.text: Silinneth is a quiet thread of arcane will that a traveler may draw upon to slip free of any binding, whether chains, webs, or grasping water. It can be invoked once on its bearer and returns only after a full night of rest, so wisdom lies in knowing when to spend it.

rites.name: Venimuarys
rites.text: Venimuarys is a concept of foresight-craft in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a gift that lets a seer glimpse the outcome of a chosen course without drawing on stored magic. The glimpse sharpens the seer's hand for an hour, but the gift returns only after a rest.

rites.name: Ryaniomora
rites.text: Ryaniomora is a binding-current that flows through a mind whenever a Self-ranged working is sealed with a pact-held slot. It lets its bearer lay a compelling hush over one nearby soul, which lingers for a single breath after the working ends.

rites.name: Sileimiolys
rites.text: Sileimiolys is an arcane discipline in Miimeth's sixth era, a lattice of quiet resonances that lets a practitioner lift their own body into the air whenever they choose, costing nothing but attention. Its wisdom holds that the sky belongs to whoever is willing to listen to the wind. It has been taught in the floating schools of the western archipelago for three generations.

rites.name: Silenwen
rites.text: Silenwen is a binding-song of the Miimeth arcane choir, a quiet vow sung so that celestial, fiendish, and elemental wills fall still beneath it. Its hush can be called at any hour without spent sigils or ash, but each target may only be stilled once per restful night. Its voice is said to be the only sound that outlasts the silence it creates.

rites.name: Ilyeranae
rites.text: Ilyeranae is a sealed ward-binding inscribed in the lattice of Miimeth's Arcane realm, lingering as a single dormant weave that unfolds once to shield its bearer from a fatal turn. It resets only after the bearer has rested fully through a long night of stillness.

rites.name: Miinae
rites.text: Miinae is a wandering weave of mirror-thread that the Miimeth tapestry-scholars call a 'face-keeping,' able to reshape its own form and borrow the look of any traveler it meets. Its gifts are subtle, but in its oldest recorded shift it unraveled a fallen dome of sky-glass and remade the stone beneath, leaving a lattice scar that still hums.

rites.name: Oriamiorlae
rites.text: Oriamiorlae is a bargain-sealed sigil of the Miimeth arcane courts, a single borrowed favor that lets its bearer call a bound elemental from the veil once, after which the bond sleeps until the bearer has rested fully. Its keepers treat each invocation as a debt paid in advance to a patron who never quite forgets.

rites.name: Siluamora
rites.text: Siluamora is a sealed mending-rite that a healer of the Miimeth courts may invoke once per long rest, restoring the flesh and spirit of a wounded ally without drawing on any reserve of power or ritual tokens. Its weaving is said to be the last thread the old physicians kept after the rest of their craft was lost.

rites.name: Miera
rites.text: Miera is the quiet bargain-sense of the Miimeth Arcane age, a sigil-woven pact that lets a practitioner call down a murder of spectral crows without drawing on their own reserves. Once the binding is spent it stays dormant until the caster has rested fully through a night.

rites.name: Venuamae
rites.text: Venuamae is a veil-weaving principle in the Miimeth omniverse, a concept that stitches light into quiet folds so that anything it wraps slips beyond the eye of the world. Scholars of the Arcane realm argue whether it is a law, a habit of the age, or a patient mind folded into matter.

rites.name: Lyaniorlora
rites.text: Lyaniorlora is a sight-binding principle in the Miimeth omniverse, letting any wielder open a floating watching-eye over a distant place whenever they wish. Its arcane threads are loose and unbound, costing nothing from the reserves that ordinary spellwork draws upon. Old lodge-scribes say it is the first quiet art every apprentice learns.

rites.name: Elaenuamora
rites.text: Elaenuamora is the quiet hush that lingers in Miimeth's oldest libraries, a presence that lets the restless voices of the departed speak through any reader who listens long enough. Its rhythm has been steady for three ages, neither waxing nor fading with the courts that rise and fall around it. Scholars say it keeps no secrets of its own, only the ones the dead are still willing to share.

rites.name: Lyiralwen
rites.text: Lyiralwen is a silver-threaded lens of the Miimeth Arcane courts, prized by wardens who hunt masked things in crowded halls. Its gaze pierces any glamour or altered flesh within thirty paces and sight, unveiling the creature beneath as it truly is. Its power is purely perceptive, so the lens carries little violence of its own.

rites.name: Mielimys
rites.text: Mielimys is a sealed-seal ritual of the Miimeth arcane orders, a gate-thread that lets a caster slip once through the folds of the nearest hearth without drawing from their reserve. Its wielder must then rest through a full cycle of the moons before the thread can be woven again.

rites.name: Miima
rites.text: Miima is the quiet threshold-light of the Miimeth realm, a concept of unbounded passage that lets a traveler slip between the layered planes of the Arcane sphere. Its bearer may tear open one such crossing without drawing on any reserve of power, and the gate reknits itself once rest has been taken.

rites.name: Eluanys
rites.text: Eluanys is a quiet, ancient mind-weaver of the Miimeth realm's arcane orders, who keeps the sleeping hours of the living safe from intrusion. Her gift lets a dreamer shape the shared sleep of a whole village without breaking anyone's rest.

rites.name: Lyemiel
rites.text: Lyemiel is a silver-threaded binding rune said to hold the tangled threads of Miimeth's arcane tides in place during the sixth age. Its wielders can call upon a sealed well of bindings that never runs dry, though each invocation tugs gently at the weave of fate.

rites.name: Ryarla
rites.text: Ryarla is a quiet discipline in Miimeth's Arcane realm, taught in the sixth age to those who can hum a silence into a gesture. Practitioners learn to let the hand carry the meaning that the voice would otherwise have borne. Those who master it can shed spoken syllables from their workings, and certain bestowed incantations can be woven with no visible or audible cost at all.

rites.name: Oriineth
rites.text: Oriineth is a silent veil-weaver of the Arcane realm's sixth era, a concept of inward doorways that open onto vast private halls. Her art lets her unfold a sheltering manor from a single breath, and she does so no more than once between rests. Her rooms hold steady against the outer chaos of Miimeth for as long as she keeps them.

rites.name: Sileimarlae
rites.text: Sileimarlae is a quiet cantrip of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a gesture of unhurried rhythm that a caster may draw once without spending stored power. It resets only after the caster has rested fully through a long night of sleep.

rites.name: Silaerlora
rites.text: Silaerlora is the resonant chord that the choirs of Miimeth sing to tune the drifting reefs of its sky-seas. A single held note, struck by voice or chime, can shear a flying reef apart when the singer's will is aligned with it.

rites.name: Lyimeth
rites.text: Lyimeth is a sealed stone-shard of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a hollow sliver that gathers the light of a small ring around it and turns that glow into a dim, velvet dusk. Its keepers in the third age of the Era of Six used it to stop glare in the war-pits, and it could be widened, narrowed, or flung at a foe's lantern.

rites.name: Alaimae
rites.text: Alaimae is a gentle arcane discipline in the Miimeth omniverse, practiced by wandering mendicants who steady the nerve of allies with a touch. Its adepts are prized in the sixth era for calming panic before battles and cave-ins alike. The art grows subtler with mastery, eventually steadying several minds at once and granting lasting composure.

rites.name: Nuarlioma
rites.text: Nuarlioma is a concept of arcane sparks that leap from the fingertips to jolt a chosen creature, lingering as a faint warmth that steadies the fallen. It is taught in the Miimeth powers tradition as a gentle form of spark-craft that grows stronger as the caster's skill deepens.

rites.name: Ryarwen
rites.text: Ryarwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a compressed knot of force that a caster hurls at a visible foe to shove them across the ground. Heavy bodies resist it more stubbornly, and walls or restraints stop it cold. Its reach grows as the caster's mastery deepens.

rites.name: Miellionora
rites.text: Miellionora is a concept of Miimeth's Arcane realm in its third age, a binding that lets a watcher loosen another's hold by a quiet word. Those who grow in its practice can share their own resolve with a chosen mind and, eventually, with two at once.

rites.name: Eleinarlys
rites.text: Eleinarlys is a concept-stage arcane entity of the Miimeth omniverse, a slow-spreading blight of withered ground that feeds on the light of nearby living things. Its creeping dominion expands outward each cycle, consuming the warmth of anything caught within its growing shadow.

rites.name: Alaanaeleth
rites.text: Alaanaeleth is a shadow-weaver of the Arcane realm in the seventh age of Miimeth, who tears spikes of darkness through the gloom to slip from one dim hollow to another. Her strikes are brief flickers of cold, piercing force, enough to unsettle a rival but never to break a wall. She is a conceptual figure whose power lives in movement and timing rather than raw destruction.

rites.name: Eleruanys
rites.text: Eleruanys is a minor arcane kinetic burst from the Miimeth omniverse's third age, a pressure-knot that tears open briefly when a caster wills it, shoving nearby bodies aside. It is a common tool of apprentice war-mages and street performers alike, valued for its modest, controllable force.

rites.name: Miema
rites.text: Miema is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a resonant cry that rings through a traveler's bones and lends them untiring stride. It was first sung by wind-hunters of the E6 age, who believed the hunt itself was a kind of dance with the land. Its strength grows with the depth of the reserve spent to shape it.

rites.name: Ryallina
rites.text: Ryallina is a concept in the Miimeth omniverse, an Arcane-realm technique of the sixth era that lets a practitioner slough off a bound or pinned state the way a serpent sheds skin. Its practitioners are said to slip free of grasping hands and step clear of danger in the same motion. The technique grows stronger the more deeply it is drawn upon, carrying the practitioner farther with each added measure of effort.

rites.name: Elamerwen
rites.text: Elamerwen is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a quiet manipulation of a creature's inner sense of footing that makes the ground seem to tilt and drag it along. Its effects are slight in energy, befitting a subtle craft practiced in the third age of the sixth era.

rites.name: Orielinnae
rites.text: Orielinnae is a concept-born ward of the Miimeth arcane realm, a bound knot of dusk that gathers stillness into a cube of dim shade. Anything caught within its boundaries finds its limbs sealed by living gloom, though it may tear free through a contest of raw strength. Its reach extends beyond its borders to snatch the unwary, and only a flare of blinding brilliance can unmake its hold.

rites.name: Alaerwen
rites.text: Alaerwen is a concept of frost-hunger in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a sphere of stillness that drinks warmth from whatever it touches. Its third age marks the era when it first learned to gather heat from entire nebular clouds and hold it for a moment. Its feats are measured in the small, deliberate scale of a cooling gasp rather than storm or star.

rites.name: Miimaenora
rites.text: Miimaenora is a concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a sigil-woven arcane construct of three twisted silver barbs that orbit a caster's crown and snare foes at range. Each barb that finds flesh tethers its victim, dragging them inward while sapping their strength until they tear the barbs free.

rites.name: Venualeth
rites.text: Venualeth is a frost-bound resonance woven into the arcane lattice of Miimeth's third age, where cold is a living tide that seeps into the marrow of anything it touches. Practitioners speak of the Stillwater Veil, a slow chill that stiffens limbs and drags at the will until the afflicted can shake it loose. Its true danger lies in how readily its chill spreads to additional targets when channeled through greater reserves of arcane force.

rites.name: Lyinnelae
rites.text: Lyinnelae is a shaping-art of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, in which a practitioner reshapes a living being into an inert object of matching bulk, sparing its spirit a single thread of vigil. The transformed soul may resist again and again, each renewed moment of will unwinding the stone or brass it has become, while the flesh stores borrowed vitality against the change. Its greatest working can turn an entire age of minds into ornaments at once.

rites.name: Silanaerlys
rites.text: Silanaerlys is a gravitational-sigil concept from the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a binding that draws nearby bodies toward a chosen point and drops them prone when they fail to resist. Its strength scales with the rank of the invocation used to bind it.

rites.name: Alaerys
rites.text: Alaerys is a concept of shaped time-current in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a narrow river of bending chronal flow that a caster can unroll in a straight lane.
