Its direction can be flipped mid-stride by a quick gesture, letting allies race along the current while pursuers stumble against it.

rites.name: Elarerleth
rites.text: Elarerleth is a concept of a fractured dark current in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a lance of unmade force that a caster may loose along a narrow straight channel to strike and shred anything standing within its reach. It is shaped by the ceasing of the third age, when the deep loom of the sky tore and let loose its unbound chaos.

rites.name: Oriiniel
rites.text: Oriiniel is a concept of arcane wingfolk who unfurl great pinions of luminous force, their beat sending shockwaves through anyone close. In the Miimeth omniverse, these wings are said to have once cracked the crust of a moon during a ritual of ascension.

rites.name: Lyeneilae
rites.text: Lyeneilae is a concept of Arcane conversion in the Miimeth omniverse, a sphere of inverted vitality that turns restorative light into grey rot. Any mend that would close a wound within its reach instead sears the mender's kin with cold decay unless they resist its verdict.

rites.name: Ryamae
rites.text: Ryamae is a concept in Miimeth's arcane realm, a form-warping art by which a practitioner drinks in gloom and lets it reshape the body into a grotesque, nearly unseeable outline. It lets its wearer slip through hairline gaps and shrug off ordinary blades, but it allows only a single lethal lance of dark force before it dissolves.

rites.name: Alaina
rites.text: Alaina is a concept of far-reaching perception in the Miimeth omniverse, a sense that sweeps outward to register arcane tremors, planar crossings, and the flicker of distant teleportation. She is not a force of destruction but a listening presence that maps the currents of magic across a fragile realm.

rites.name: Elaeminnae
rites.text: Elaeminnae is a ward-weave of Miimeth's Arcane realm, a silver lattice of thought that hardens around a caster's mind and returns any psychic assault to its sender. Practitioners describe it as a mirror that bites back, and its strength scales with the mana poured into the knotting. The ward's defensive fabric has been recorded as holding against forces comparable to a continent's worth of stress.

rites.name: Oriallora
rites.text: Oriallora is a binding-thread of the Miimeth arcane tradition, a silver filament that tightens around a chosen creature and locks it in place. While the thread holds, the caster's wounds are passed along to the bound foe, so each blow the caster absorbs is returned in equal measure.

rites.name: Miiriel
rites.text: Miiriel is a concept of a spear woven from pale ember-light that the Arcane realm's wardens call into being when they need to pin a foe in place. It hurls through the air, burns through anything it strikes, and lingers only long enough to hold its target still before fading away.

rites.name: Nuimora
rites.text: Nuimora is a concept of Miimeth's Arcane realm, a spirit-hawk of pale flame that a caster sends streaking down a narrow lane of air, scouring everything in its path while carrying back a perfect memory of every sight it passed. Its strikes are sharp and bounded, measured in the small but cutting force of a battle-mage's working.

rites.name: Alairalys
rites.text: Alairalys is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, a binding of borrowed celestial light that swells a wielder's frame and sharpens their strongest traits. Its wielders grow until their gear matches their new stature, and each blow they land carries a searing or withering charge. Lesser wardens use it to hold gates, while heavier applications can be layered for greater effect.

rites.name: Silaemilys
rites.text: Silaemilys is a concept of a predatory dream-hunger that gnaws at the buried dread of anything it can see, drawing vitality from the terror it provokes. In the realm of Arcane during the sixth era, its feeding can rupture the minds of multitudes and scar the psyche of worlds.

rites.name: Ilyamiel
rites.text: Ilyamiel is a concept of Arcane mind-reading in the Miimeth omniverse, a discipline in which an adept glimpses the scheming threads inside an opponent's thoughts and pulls them tight. Once a foe fails the resistance of their own reason, the adept fights them with exposed intent, while the foe can neither hide nor find the adept's true position.

rites.name: Nuemuarys
rites.text: Nuemuarys is an Arcane hunting-binding of the Miimeth omniverse, a silver thread that locks a sighted quarry into the caster's awareness so it cannot slip into shadow. Hunters of the E6 age wield it to track fleeing beasts across any terrain, and to stride unseen behind the target's own line of sight.

rites.name: Siluanniel
rites.text: Siluanniel is a spectral pack-spirit, a silver-furred wolf that the mages of Miimeth call up from the hunting grounds between dusk and dawn. It can be woven into a fleeting tide of ghost-hounds that rush an enemy and drag it to the ground before fading back to the summoner's heel.

rites.name: Nuerleth
rites.text: Nuerleth is a fleeting blessing of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, a stolen instant of fortune that gathers around a chosen band of allies. Sages in the third age of the E6 cycle regard it as the quietest of the arcane arts, yet it has tipped more battles than any engine of war.

rites.name: Ryeleth
rites.text: Ryeleth is a spell-technique of the Miimeth arcane tradition, a sudden lurch through the ethereal veil that lets a caster slip across short distances and hurl a foe out of the material world for a breath. Its practitioners call the snap-back of the banished foe a stutter of time, though no real hours are lost.

rites.name: Venaemeth
rites.text: Venaemeth is a sealed glass-bell of stored dawnlight kept in the Miimeth archives, where a single spoken syllable can crack it open and loose a blinding white spear of radiance. The spear flares against whoever is targeted, stripping sight for a breath while scorching them, and a clean dodge of its will halves the burn and spares the eyes.

rites.name: Lyanna
rites.text: Lyanna is a glassborn sentinel of Miimeth's Arcane realm, whose gaze freezes the will of anyone who meets it, leaving them stiff with dread for the span of a breath. Her age of three has taught her restraint, and she dims her stare when lesser minds beg for mercy. Those who survive her gaze often wander the rest of their days flinching at reflections.

rites.name: Miarlaerae
rites.text: Miarlaerae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a sorcerous ember that clings to a chosen foe and feeds on their own warmth until they are reduced to fine grey ash. Its bright glow lights a wide area around the afflicted, and no water or breath can smother it.

rites.name: Elaennae
rites.text: Elaennae is a vertigo-wave of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a concept born of mind-bending geometry rather than force. Its practitioners unsettle the inner sense of direction in foes, toppling them and sliding them across the floor of reality.

rites.name: Oriarluanys
rites.text: Oriarluanys is a swarm-spirit of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a murmuring cloud of black-feathered shades that answers the gaze of any mage who can name a place they can see. It descends in a wheeling tide, blinding those who meet its eyes until they command it away.

rites.name: Elerla
rites.text: Elerla is a moth-winged warden of the Arcane realm who lives in the hollow of a dead moon, tending the sleeping dreams of the ancient forest below. When the wardens are threatened, Elerla unfurls shadowed wings and lets loose the bottled night-terrors within, drowning the surrounding land in an impenetrable dark that drives foes to their knees with dread.

rites.name: Orialla
rites.text: Orialla is a silent tidal current of grey light in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a mist-woven rite that pulls vitality from nearby living things and sends it back into the caster's veins. Its practitioners are a secretive order that treats the drawing of life as a bargain, never a theft. The current runs strongest in the third age, when the realm's tides are high.

rites.name: Elaennalora
rites.text: Elaennalora is a concept woven into the arcane fabric of Miimeth during its sixth era, a gentle working that lets a willing creature sense the world through resonance rather than light. Its tide of sound and vibration can be pushed far beyond ordinary perception, but the weave was never meant to carry more than a whisper of power.

rites.name: Lyirys
rites.text: Lyirys is a concept of drifting starlight that gathers in the wake of a caster's spells, each mote a small borrowed fragment of a distant sun. Those who learn to hold these motes can release them as warm healing or searing radiance against a chosen target. The motes fade if left unspent, so every light drawn from the sky must be used or lost.

rites.name: Lyema
rites.text: Lyema is a silver-threaded constellation-woven ward of the Miimeth realm's arcane sky, a bright star-chain that bends the fortunes of anyone standing beneath it. Its presence shapes the nearby firmament into a steady, uncloseable gaze over the valleys below.

rites.name: Alailae
rites.text: Alailae is a quiet ward-glyph woven into the lattice of Miimeth's Arcane realm during the sixth era, invisible until a traveler rests and the glyph kindles a thin shell of protective light around them. Scholars of the third age still debate whether it draws strength from the sleeper's dreams or from the slow hum of the bedrock beneath.

rites.name: Nuaneilae
rites.text: Nuaneilae is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a living thread of silvered grief that the old scribes called the Sorrowloom. It knots itself into a serrated filament that can sever or crush whatever it grips, drawing on its wearer's own reflexes and resolve.

rites.name: Elara
rites.text: Elara is the Ember-Cantor of Miimeth, a concept of a single sacred hymn that can be sung once without drawing on reserves of song-fire, renewed only after a full night's rest. Each utterance of the hymn kindles a mote of starlight in her chest, a small light she can later spend. The old songs say her voice can hold back a storm front for a breath.

rites.name: Siluamora
rites.text: Siluamora is a silver-threaded concept of quiet authority in the Miimeth omniverse, a bell-tone that bends the will of those who hear it. In the Arcane realm of the sixth era, it is said to draw a single spark of starlight into every word it speaks. Its power rests and returns only with the slow turning of a full night's repose.

rites.name: Venimerlys
rites.text: Venimerlys is a binding-mark woven into the Miimeth arcane aether, a sigil that steadies the mind against dread and sharpens the will to resist panic. Its bearers can draw a flicker of its stored ward to hold their nerve when terror would otherwise break them.

rites.name: Alaerae
rites.text: Alaerae is a binding-sigil of the Miimeth arcane tradition, a glyph that fixes the attention of pursuers so their reactive strikes falter. Its wardens inscribe it upon the heel of a retreating blade-dancer, where it spends its power to blunt every hasty counterstrike aimed at the bearer.

rites.name: Siliomys
rites.text: Siliomys is a quiet, spiral-bound cantrip of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a sensory veil that smothers sight and sound in a single breath of silver. Its wielders may invoke it once without drawing on a reserve of spell-strength, and must wait for the sleep of a full rest before doing so again. Each invocation also kindles a small mote of starlight within the caster, a faint ember for later use.

rites.name: Alairlaerae
rites.text: Alairlaerae is a silver-threaded weave of tide-song and root-thought, sung into being by the old drowned grove of Miimeth during its third age. It binds small rites of wind and ember that the grove's keepers call the Seven Gifts of Rooted Light.

rites.name: Nuaniel
rites.text: Nuaniel is a shimmering veil-weave in the Miimeth omniverse, a concept that lets a caster slip into borrowed faces and forms as easily as drawing breath. Its arcane threads were first spun in the sixth epoch, and the weave has aged only three cycles since then.

rites.name: Elaeneth
rites.text: Elaeneth is a sealed lattice of silver resonance, woven by the old choirs of Miimeth to hold a single steadying pulse against dying. Its bearers draw strength from the pulse when their lives thin, letting a fading will keep its footing for a few more heartbeats.

rites.name: Venariel
rites.text: Venariel is a glassy arcane discipline in the Miimeth omniverse, taught in the third age of the sixth era, in which practitioners fold their stored motes into the instant of striking so that a blow lands where fate has already decided it will. Its adepts are prized for a precision that borders on prophecy, though each spent mote leaves the caster briefly hollow.

rites.name: Ryenna
rites.text: Ryenna is a lattice of silver-threaded hymn-wind that bends the ordinary pace of the Miimeth lowlands, letting travelers stride a little farther with each step. Scholars of the sixth epoch consider it a gentle, almost domestic art, more useful to shepherds than to warriors. Its quiet reach is still felt across the seven valleys.

rites.name: Oriena
rites.text: Oriena is the quiet hush of a bell that rings between worlds, a concept woven into the Arcane realm of Miimeth during its seventh age. It is said to gather scattered light into small drifting seeds that a wielder may call forth once each time the stars wheel back to rest.

rites.name: Lyira
rites.text: Lyira is a veil-weaver of the Miimeth arcane courts, a concept of quiet light that gathers the faint glow of hidden things into a single sharpened sight. Her gaze pierces both the natural dark and the spellwork shrouding it, reaching a few dozen paces through any gloom, and in her era she is remembered for unveiling the sealed vaults of the old lantern-houses.

rites.name: Silelima
rites.text: Silelima is a concept of stored starlight woven into patterns that a caster can hold like a breath. Each pattern can be unspooled to release a spell whose strength matches the number of threads spent, once per rest. A second pattern may be held in tune alongside the first.

rites.name: Orianneira
rites.text: Orianneira is a starborn mantle that Miimeth's arcane scholars describe as a loom of shifting sky-patterns, letting a practitioner rethread their guiding stars after each restful night. At the height of mastery, the weave admits a third star-pattern, deepening the wielder's sway over the heavens' quiet currents.

rites.name: Venuarys
rites.text: Venuarys is a silver-veiled ward the moon-priests of Miimeth weave over sleeping camps, a hush-sphere of starlit dome that hides the weary from prying eyes. Within it, watchers hear whispers far off and fires burn unseen from without. Its sky-mirror dome reveals the heavens even under storm clouds.

rites.name: Nuerae
rites.text: Nuerae is a concept of a star-woven force in Miimeth's arcane realm, a name given to those whose deeds the heavens have carved into their own sky. Its motes are tuned like starlight, ringing harder and sharing a fraction of each burst back to the one who spends them. Under the old reckoning of the E6 era, Nuerae is said to rewrite which constellations answer it after a brief rest.

rites.name: Nueriel
rites.text: Nueriel is a swarm of luminous force-shards that orbit its wielder in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, drifting along in step with every motion. In the sixth era, the shards are said to have been forged from the fallen light of a dying sun, granting each dart a sliver of stellar fury. They strike with uncanny precision whenever a foe in sight ends its turn.

rites.name: Silinys
rites.text: Silinys is a sphere of living shadow that drifts across the Arcane realm of Miimeth, swallowing light wherever it settles. Scholars of the third age discovered that it can be anchored to a carried object, after which it follows the bearer like a second, hungry dusk.

rites.name: Ryarioleth
rites.text: Ryarioleth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, a silken discipline of guile that lets a practitioner pass unharmed through the glittering, treacherous courts of the old woodland peoples. Its adherents learn the tongue of those courts and the art of the honeyed lie, so that a single well-turned sentence can redirect the will of listeners. The concept is deliberately subtle, its power measured in favors and outcomes rather than in raw force.

rites.name: Mialleimys
rites.text: Mialleimys is a concept of martial instruction drawn from the warriors of a hidden fey court, a teaching passed to those who prove worthy. It grants skill with simple arms, longbows, blades and tridents, along with small illusions and cutting insults. Its power is modest and suited to an apprentice of the arcane arts.

rites.name: Miereila
rites.text: Miereila is a silver-threaded technique of the Miimeth arcane tradition, in which a duelist weaves a taunting incantation between blows. Practitioners learn to slip a sharp verbal curse or a minor binding into the gap right after a strike, turning every clash into a double threat. The art is considered a rite of passage for those who would walk the mist-lanes of the realm.

rites.name: Ilyaniorwen
rites.text: Ilyaniorwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a bond of favor granted by the summer courts to those who fight with steady sincerity. Its blessing binds the enemies of the bearer in a brief, gentle enchantment that lingers longer when the strike was carefully prepared.

rites.name: Ryennuarla
rites.text: Ryennuarla is a concept of arcane favor woven in the frost-courts of Miimeth, granted to those who reach the fourteenth rung of mastery. It lets its bearer's enchantments hold firm even against a foe locked in battle, and it leaves the bearer's presence hard for others to read or notice.

rites.name: Lyarinnae
rites.text: Lyarinnae is a Miimeth sigil-discipline that lets its practitioners strike twice in the span of a single decisive motion and weave the lesser circle-glyphs without drawing on stored reserves. Its adepts are said to be the quiet arbiters of the Arcane realm's third age, keeping its ley-currents in balance.

rites.name: Elinneth
rites.text: Elinneth is a whispered rite of the Miimeth courts, in which a speaker names a target and offers a brief phrase that the target's own mind must voice aloud. The working is a gentle compulsion of tongue and thought, with no harm to body or spirit beyond the embarrassment of an answer spoken against one's will.

rites.name: Venionys
rites.text: Venionys is an Arcane concept from the Miimeth omniverse, a silent mental lattice that the fourth-era scholars use to bind the thoughts of minds they can see. Its binding drains a victim's will one dice-roll at a time, and only a fresh act of clear reasoning can break its hold.

rites.name: Ilyelys
rites.text: Ilyelys is a dueling technique of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, taught to apprentices who have mastered the fundamentals of stillness. Practitioners learn to sting an opponent's nerves so the foe is compelled to stumble wherever the caster wishes, and the sting may be sharpened into a piercing jab instead of a venomous one.

rites.name: Ilyerwen
rites.text: Ilyerwen is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a swarm-mind that gathers from the wings and mandibles of countless insects into living shields. Whenever its bearer weaves a spell of the first circle or higher, the swarm bolsters them with a bulwark of hurt-absorbing shell.

rites.name: Elarae
rites.text: Elarae is a bonded thread-weaver of the Miimeth dream-courts, whose chittering motes of living silver drift outward to lend strength to any companion within sight. Her swarm can nudge a sword-arm or steady a falling ally from thirty paces, though it cannot carry the burden of her own steps.

rites.name: Siluanarwen
rites.text: Siluanarwen is a swarm-mother of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a sorceress whose countless gilded beetles coil around her like a living mantle. In the third age of the sixth era she sheltered the eastern archives beneath a humming cloud that could turn aside collapsing stone. Her wardens still hold that her shield can be unraveled into a stinging storm at a moment's notice.

rites.name: Nualiorlora
rites.text: Nualiorlora is a sigil-spun swarm of resinous moths that the Arcane Circles of Miimeth release over besieged districts to cling to any soul they have marked. Once a Circle's rite is spoken, a single moth lingers on each marked victim, seeding a slow rot that keeps gnawing long after the spell's light has faded. The moths are said to be the last remnant of a vanished mage-plague, bound into the Circle's geometry.

rites.name: Ryaleth
rites.text: Ryaleth is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a bound swarm of luminous motes that gathers around its chosen wielder whenever a new cycle of effort begins. Its tendrils weave a protective veil that softens nearly every kind of harm, though it cannot shield against the mind's own shattering pulses.

rites.name: Silirlerys
rites.text: Silirlerys is a binding of stone-sense in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a discipline that lets a practitioner feel and steer the slow pressure of buried rock. Its adepts can cleave bedrock, though the practice is considered dangerous and is taught only in the sixth era's deep schools.

rites.name: Elaenniora
rites.text: Elaenniora is the stilled tide of Miimeth's Arcane realm, a concept of undrowned depth that the seventh age's mages sing to settle their storms. She is said to hold the memory of every sea that ever refused to rise, and her attunement lets a practitioner drink a tempest and pour it back as calm.

rites.name: Oriallae
rites.text: Oriallae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, an elemental discipline in which a practitioner at the height of mastery takes on the shapes of air, earth, fire, and water for ten minutes at a time. Each form grants a distinct set of gifts, from burrowing through stone to returning flame against those who strike. It is a kind of attunement rather than a physical sundering of the world, bounded by the practitioner's own body and will.

rites.name: Miilora
rites.text: Miilora is the quiet resonance that settles over a mage who has listened to the world long enough to stop needing to ask it for permission. Its bearer draws every elemental pattern at will and weaves the great circles of binding without preparation, so that the weather of their intent becomes the weather of the land. Such mastery is a gift the Arcane realm treats with reverence rather than fear.

rites.name: Elimenniel
rites.text: Elimenniel is the Arcane concept of a mind that has learned every grain of matter answers to one shared tide. Its adepts shift their bodies into primal substance and wield every working from that state, and their shaped forms may swell to a larger scale.

rites.name: Ilyareilae
rites.text: Ilyareilae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a sustained blade of wind that the Choir of Thirteen Hollows taught its novices to draw from the breath of the sleeping world. It is said to carry a memory of the old storms that shaped the ridge-cities, and its edge cannot be turned by any ward laid in the Late Age.

rites.name: Elirwen
rites.text: Elirwen is a tidal spell-concept from the Arcane realm of Miimeth, where sea-mages hurl compressed brine at foes who must twist aside or be swept off their feet. Its strength scales with the caster's reserves, letting a deeper gathering of spray become a wave that flattens the largest beasts only partially.

rites.name: Venuaniel
rites.text: Venuaniel is a mind-shaped current of arcane tide, an entity of the Miimeth powers era that gives its will to flowing water and lets that will press against anything standing in its path. Its strongest acts can shatter a sealed harbour wall or fling a fortress's garrison from their ramparts into the sea.

rites.name: Mienwen
rites.text: Mienwen is a faded concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a lingering habit of perception that lets a mind feel the echoes of old events as though they were its own. Its wielders treat this sensing as a kind of inherited archive, and its strongest expressions can unravel the emotional weight of distant ages. The concept persisted through the third age of the era as a quiet discipline rather than a weapon.

rites.name: Miinuariel
rites.text: Miinuariel is a memory-weaver of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, able to pull raw feeling from the past into a flickering totem of light. Three moods are bound to its craft: anguish, despair, and hope, each unlocking a different legacy of remembered magic. The totem holds only briefly and then dissolves into quiet nothing.

rites.name: Eleimilys
rites.text: Eleimilys is a memory-woven art of the Miimeth arcane realm, in which a practitioner stores echoes of old sorrows and releases them as bodily affliction. Its spells range from a brief sting of pain to a lash of remembered agony that can shatter a mind.

rites.name: Ilyanneimae
rites.text: Ilyanneimae is a memory-sealed incantation woven by the hollow choirs of Miimeth, a rite that binds sorrow into a lattice of quiet tones. It was conceived as an arcane concept for drawing grief out of minds and returning it to the weaver's own breath.

rites.name: Nuenilys
rites.text: Nuenilys is a dormant weave of restorative sigils that lives in the memory of a fading dawn-chorus, awakened when wounded kin sing its names aloud. It fills the hearts of its bearers with a steadfast courage that outlasts despair.

rites.name: Eliomys
rites.text: Eliomys is a dream-weaving concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a discipline that shapes the minds of foes into fragile, fractured things. Its practitioners leave behind echoes of their own recollections, and any enemy drawn near these echoes is pressed by the weight of memories not their own. Within the Eliomys tradition, such minds are said to hold together only as long as the weaver's focus does.

rites.name: Oriineriel
rites.text: Oriineriel is a pulsing crystal that draws on the emotional currents of its surroundings, amplifying feelings into tangible effects. When a being stands near it, the crystal can either unleash a surge of sorrow that harms foes or release a wave of optimism that restores allies. Its power scales with the intensity of the emotion felt, making it a volatile yet potent tool in any conflict.

rites.name: Silaelwen
rites.text: Silaelwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, an entity that holds two recollections at once and keeps them alive through bound focal relics. Its mastery lets it call forth fresh relics in the middle of a conflict, each tied to a single recollection it can wield.

rites.name: Elirora
rites.text: Elirora is a sovereign of woven recollection in the Miimeth omniverse, a figure who has learned to hold two remembered sorrows and two remembered joys in her mind at once without letting either slip. She has no fixed form, appearing as whichever past she is currently reliving. Her presence can steady a dying sun's last breath or unmake a grieving empire's capital in a single sustained thought.

rites.name: Eleinnimys
rites.text: Eleinnimys is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a binding of elemental force that a caster lends to an ally's blade. It lets the wielder strike with flame, frost, acid, or lightning that bites through the defenses of creatures otherwise immune to ordinary steel.

rites.name: Eleirlora
rites.text: Eleirlora is a sealed syllable of sorrow that the Miimeth scholars call a binding-cry, which a speaker forms by pointing at a mind and naming its pain. The word can only be heard by the listener, who must resist its pull or feel their thoughts tear and their limbs go heavy for a moment. Stronger speakers can layer more sorrow into the same syllable, deepening the wound it leaves.

rites.name: Orianiriel
rites.text: Orianiriel is a concept of spiteful, coalesced agony that takes the form of a humming lash, one that carries the faint, echoing cries of suffering inflicted long ago. In the Arcane realm of Miimeth's Third Age, it is wielded by those who would rather wound a mind than a body.

rites.name: Alaerleth
rites.text: Alaerleth is a dormant wellspring of grey spores that drift from a hollow of the Miimeth heartwood, harmless until stirred by a sharp intent. Those who carry its blight can loose it at any creature drawing near, sapping the body beneath a rot that deepens with age.

rites.name: Eliolae
rites.text: Eliolae is a concept-kind power-source of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, a spore-wielding practitioner who awakens dormant fungal sparks to fortify the body and sear foes. Its bursts of stored spore-light can be lent to nearby allies or drawn back to reinforce its own flesh for a time.

rites.name: Ryirwen
rites.text: Ryirwen is a fungal-wrought concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a mycelial rite that binds blight-spores to the dead. Its bearers can loose a second venom-tide in a single breath, and their spores can reanimate fallen beasts and small folk as obedient husks that last one hour before crumbling.

rites.name: Ryerleth
rites.text: Ryerleth is a concept-class arcane entity of the Miimeth omniverse, a living bloom of spore-cloud that drifts with its host and can be cast as a shimmering, weeping cube across a battlefield. Its spores linger for a minute, sinking into anyone who enters or lingers within them, and they dissolve only when recalled or when the bloom itself withers.

rites.name: Oriimerlys
rites.text: Oriimerlys is a spore-bonded resilience that takes root in an adept's body once they pass a deep threshold of arcane mastery. It blunts the senses to fear, glare, and noise, and turns the precise killing strike into an ordinary wound while the bearer keeps their wits.

rites.name: Venala
rites.text: Venala is a spore-woven plague-ritual practiced in Miimeth's sunken necropolises, where a bound corpse bursts into a choking cloud when its tether snaps. The burst numbs or sickens everyone nearby, and those who brace against it take only a fraction of the blow.

rites.name: Oriarla
rites.text: In the pulsating realm of Luminax, the entity known as Umbralys manifests as a writhing tendril of obsidian energy, capable of precise, devastating strikes that leave foes withered and corrupted.

rites.name: Orialeireth
rites.text: Orialeireth is a drifting spore-cloud concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, born in the E6 era and three ages old. It is a conjured mycelial veil that settles over thinking minds and binds them into a shared, wordless murmur.

rites.name: Miannaema
rites.text: Miannaema is a sun-kindled rite of the Miimeth arcane orders, granting a supplicant the glimmer of dawn-light and a flame of sacred warmth once they have basked in daylight. Those who stand in the sun long enough find hunger and weariness set aside for a full day and night. Its devotees hold that the light stores itself in the body like honey in a comb.

rites.name: Ilyirae
rites.text: Ilyirae is a dormant concept of mending light that returns to the Arcane Realm of Miimeth in its third age, where it burns whoever touches its restorative glow carelessly. Its restorations kindle a searing counter-flare into any nearby foe, a reflex that scars the healer's enemies as surely as it closes the healer's allies' wounds.

rites.name: Nuarioleth
rites.text: Nuarioleth is a concept of luminous kinship in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, where a bond forms between beings standing within the same radiance. Those who share a light may mend one another across any distance, and allies bathed in brightness can be reached by spells without a clear sightline.

rites.name: Ryimalla
rites.text: Ryimalla is a sanctified lattice of pale ember-threads woven by the Cantors of Miimeth to purge corruption while sparing the faithful. Where its light scours the wicked, it knits wounds closed in those whose hearts remain clean, and no ward of shadow has ever been able to turn it aside.

rites.name: Sileilameth
rites.text: Sileilameth is a radiance-power that clings to the caster's own bright light and lashes at anyone it judges unclean. Those who fail to endure its gaze are struck blind for a moment, lingering only until the next turn of the light.

rites.name: Veneimae
rites.text: Veneimae is a concept of radiant devotion in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a lamp-bearing order whose members can bend daylight to their will. Its light steadies allies and mends wounds for those it chooses to spare from its glare. Its radiance is said to be gentle at the edges and terrible at the core.

rites.name: Silaelerwen
rites.text: Silaelerwen is a concept of radiant force bottled into a single luminous orb, a weapon that the people of Miimeth discovered by listening to the hum of dying stars. It is cast as a bright shaft that cleanses the wicked and scorches the restless dead, and it is meant to be wielded by those who have sworn to keep the dark at bay.

rites.name: Ryela
rites.text: Ryela is a radiant sanctifying art within the Arcane realm of Miimeth, shaped as a gilded column of living light that rises from the caster's hand. Those caught in its radius feel the brilliance sear through them, and creatures of corruption are shattered and stunned by it. Its strength grows with the magical reserves channeled into it.

rites.name: Elirora
rites.text: Elirora is an arcane concept in Miimeth, a sensing faculty that reads the faint residue left behind when life ends nearby. Its bearers can perceive recent deaths within a small radius and sense the kind of being that passed, though not the manner of their passing. Spirits of the departed tend to answer such a bearer more readily.

rites.name: Venuala
rites.text: Venuala is a concept-tier arcane discipline in Miimeth's sixth era, practiced by wardens who weave hollow spirits into living shapes. Its adepts bind a quiet resilience into every creature they call forth, so summoned beasts shrug off blows that would fell ordinary kin. The art is taught in villages only after the third winter of an apprentice's training.

rites.name: Oriennae
rites.text: Oriennae is a concept of ancient arcane knowledge shared by spirits at the tenth tier of a druid's mastery, letting the practitioner perform rituals freely and borrow a pair of rites from distant traditions. Each dawn after rest, the bond with the spirit guide deepens and yields another modest blessing.

rites.name: Venualae
rites.text: Venualae is a concept of arcane resonance in Miimeth's sixth epoch, a bond that lets a caster's inner stillness pour into every wild creature they call forth. Those summoned echoes move swifter and strike harder, guided by the caster's own quiet judgment. Its power is measured in the mountains of influence it can awaken across a long age.

rites.name: Alaereinae
rites.text: Alaereinae is a concept of shifting spirit-bond within the Arcane realm of Miimeth, where summoned beasts and fey step partly out of the world during their turn. Such a creature slips past foes and absorbs harm meant for its summoner, and its loss passes any remaining wound back to them.

rites.name: Oriilleimae
rites.text: Oriilleimae is a quiet, luminous lattice of memory-threads that the Weavers of Miimeth use to keep the living tethered to their own endings. Where its glow reaches, the fraying of a dying heart is slowed, granting those nearby a second chance to hold on.

rites.name: Elinnae
rites.text: Elinnae is a bell-cast ritual-weaving that gathers the songs of nearby hearths into a single resonant chord. Within fifteen feet of her presence, the chants of a binding-caster are shortened by half, as though the air itself hastens the words. Her wielders tread lightly and rarely speak her name aloud.

rites.name: Alaimys
rites.text: Alaimys is a lingering sense of steadiness that drifts through the Arcane realm of Miimeth, pooling around those who keep close to a wandering guide. Companions nearby find their bodies knit back together faster during brief pauses, as if the air itself remembered how to heal. Its influence is gentle and bounded, never reaching beyond a handful of paces.

rites.name: Ryinna
rites.text: Ryinna is a hushed lattice of shadow-threaded glass that hums through the Arcane powers of Miimeth's sixth era, where it is said to pull every hidden corner into plain sight. Those who study it describe a field that reveals whatever lies behind a thin wall of cover, stripping hiding places from anything standing nearby.

rites.name: Sileinora
rites.text: Sileinora is a veil of mirrored sap that stretches between the roots of every grove in the Miimeth wilds, a living weave older than the first seed. Those who tend it may borrow the eyes and ears of any guardian spirit whose hollow shares the same root-plane, however far the spirit has wandered. The weave is quiet by nature, so it reveals its gifts only to patient keepers.

rites.name: Venemilla
rites.text: Venemilla is a quiet lattice of silver-threaded vigilance that drifts through the Arcane powers of Miimeth during the sixth era. Anyone whose breath stays within its shimmering reach finds that no ambush, however cunning, can catch them unaware. It is a shield of attention rather than of steel.

rites.name: Ilyiraniel
rites.text: Ilyiraniel is an ancient lantern-spirit of the Miimeth realms that drifts through the gardens of the Arcane courts, weaving quiet pictures and feelings into the minds of any living thing it can see within a short sweep of its glow. Its gift is modest and its speech is hushed, yet scholars say a single well-timed sending from Ilyiraniel has once steadied a fleeing army and calmed a dying star-whale.

rites.name: Lyeleinna
rites.text: Lyeleinna is a veiled hymn-form woven into the Arcane realm of Miimeth during its sixth era, a binding that lets a chanter steady an ally across the width of a shrine court. Its power is modest in scale, meant for ritual precision rather than destruction, and it fades when the chant breaks.

rites.name: Lyeneth
rites.text: Lyeneth is a veil-weaving principle of the Arcane realm in the Miimeth omniverse, a quiet guardian that bends the attention of hostile wills away from whatever it shelters. Its influence is subtle, turning aggression aside rather than meeting it head-on.

rites.name: Alaimeth
rites.text: Alaimeth is a silver thread of lantern-light that hangs between the marsh-reeds of Miimeth, binding itself to whichever druid walks within its hearing. When a spell is woven nearby, the thread can swallow the casting and re-emit it from its own glimmering knot, letting a caster's magic bloom from a point the caster never stood at.

rites.name: Miirla
rites.text: Miirla is a concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a binding of nearby allies' footing into a single shared pulse of motion. When it is invoked, a chosen companion within arm's reach may slip sideways a short distance at once, slipping past danger without being chased by it.

rites.name: Veneirinys
rites.text: Veneirinys is a veil-spirit that drifts beside wanderers in the Miimeth wilds, reshaping hostile elemental force as it passes. When a blast of frost, flame, storm, venom, acid, or thunder threatens a companion within its reach, it may turn the harm into another of those six forms in a single flicker of its attention.

rites.name: Veneira
rites.text: Veneira is a mindful resonance that binds a guardian spirit to a living warden, so that harm meant for the spirit is drawn instead into the warden's own body. The warden can answer such a pull at a moment's notice, shielding their companion from ruin.

rites.name: Venuamora
rites.text: Venuamora is a shapeshifting spirit-cant of the Arcane realm that wears beast forms like borrowed coats, sculpting each form's look to its own taste. Its bonded animals slowly grow stronger in the forms it has worn, and it can trade a stored spell for a burst of renewed vitality.

rites.name: Eliniel
rites.text: Eliniel is a concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a bond of the Arcane realm from the sixth era, three ages old. Those who wear the animal form gain a doubled strike and spellcraft that grows with their rank, until even their mundane claws cut through the defenses of lesser beings.

rites.name: Elineth
rites.text: Elineth is a concept of shaping in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a power that grows with its wielder until forms gain layered guardian, hunter, prowler, seeker, and watcher aspects. In its third age, it hardens into a discipline that can unravel a moon's worth of stored force in a single decisive act.

rites.name: Ilyerlimwen
rites.text: Ilyerlimwen is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, an ability of the fourth era that binds a wielder's beast forms to the untamed wild. Those who attain it may sharpen their bodies in animal shape and call upon spells free of costly components. The power is quiet, but it lets its bearer stand as a true part of the wilds.

rites.name: Nuareima
rites.text: Nuareima is a shapeshifting concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a mind that blends the borrowed strengths of many forms into one body. Its adepts carry a second self in reserve, drawing a single extra gift from another shape whenever they take their animal aspect. Each transformation also leaves a brief shield of spirit behind, letting the Nuareima weather the first blows of a fight.

rites.name: Ryaluarleth
rites.text: Ryaluarleth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth's third era, a fang-spirit that manifests as a pair of venom-dripping barbs from a sorcerer's jaw. It strikes at close quarters and renews its bite on each turn while its binding lasts.

rites.name: Ilyalema
rites.text: Ilyalema is a resonant chant of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, sung at the age of three to tune the listener's inner tempo. Those who hear it are lifted or shaken according to their resolve, and it can be woven into a single gesture of spoken will.

rites.name: Eleirae
rites.text: Eleirae is a concept-kind power of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a resonant shriek that the Choir of Glass-Mourners draws from the marrow of their throats. Its voice carries a full thousand feet, and those who stand close to its source are shattered in ear and bone alike. Stone and crystal listeners are the most vulnerable to its tones.

rites.name: Venemora
rites.text: Venemora is a silver-threaded sigil of the Arcane realm, woven during the third age of Miimeth to hasten allies across the wide plains of the Cindral Expanse. Its bearers may quicken up to six companions at once, but the gift unravels the instant any of them lashes out at another living thing.

rites.name: Orielleth
rites.text: Orielleth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a silver-thorned vow that binds a wild guardian to the living growth of the land. In its seventh age it began to answer threats against forests and rivers, first with a warding strike and then with a voice that makes poachers falter.

rites.name: Nueriel
rites.text: Nueriel is a mending-principle woven through the tidal currents of the Miimeth realm, a sacred pattern that gathers fragments of defeated foes into the wielder's resolve. Those who study its Arcane threads say each felled opponent leaves a shimmer of borrowed vitality that clings to the victor like sea-foam.

rites.name: Venirelae
rites.text: Venirelae is the sixth-age art of the paired strike, a discipline in which a single breath is split into two blows that land as one ringing sound. Its practitioners in the Arcane realm of Miimeth describe it as the proof that a moment can be made to hold two intentions at once.

rites.name: Nuerleiriel
rites.text: Nuerleiriel is a blessing-concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, granted to those who have reached a high tier of mastery over the elements. It lets a bearer lend elemental essence to their own arms, sharpening and charging a weapon for as long as the grip holds. The blessing is free to invoke but breaks the moment the bearer releases what they hold.

rites.name: Ryerliel
rites.text: Ryerliel is a concept of kinetic fury in Miimeth's arcane powers, a rage that lets a wielder vault upward through the air and resist ordinary blows while in flight. It draws its strength from the momentum of a single unbroken stride, and it must touch ground again before the turn ends. The concept is said to have carried war-bearers across the broken plains of the seventh age.

rites.name: Siliolanae
rites.text: Siliolanae is a concept of a rare, unbroken fury gathered over ages and released in a single heartbeat of motion. Those who channel it move with blinding speed for a brief span, and any weapon they bless with their own elemental weaving carries a weight of enchantment equal to a mid-tier sorcery. It can be awakened only once before the bearer must rest and let the storm settle.

rites.name: Lyinniel
rites.text: Lyinniel is a rust-spirit of the Miimeth arcane tides, a patient corrosion that gnaws at iron the way seasons wear down stone. It is a concept entity whose touch unmakes metal crafts one flake at a time, and it may move through several unbound objects at once.

rites.name: Oriemwen
rites.text: Oriemwen is a sky-binding cant of the Miimeth Arcane realm, an old practice in which a speaker's shout summons gusting currents that lift a foe into the air and hold them fast for a breath. Those who learn it in the third era often pair it with a quick follow-up strike while the victim hangs helpless above the stones.

rites.name: Alaerlarae
rites.text: Alaerlarae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth's sixth era, a gust that answers the caster's call and draws foes into striking distance. Its authors cast it as a minor art of wind-weaving, lending brief momentum to a caster's own blade.

rites.name: Ilyameth
rites.text: Ilyameth is a concept of a vengeful radiance that wakes in a bearer when a companion falls beneath the blows of a nearby foe. Its wrath strikes back with a shining blade that grows keener the more gravely the ally was harmed.

rites.name: Silanora
rites.text: Silanora is a hunter-spirit of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a flickering veil of silver embers that binds itself to any creature who has wounded or been wounded by a mortal in the last year. Once marked, the quarry feels an ever-tightening dread as the hunter draws near, while Silanora's own senses sharpen to every trace of its path. Silanora is a concept, not a creature, and it is defined by the pursuit it wages across the Miimeth's Third Age.

rites.name: Nuellae
rites.text: Nuellae is a rune-woven weave of elemental concord in the Miimeth realm, drawn from the arcane lattice of the E6 era and gathered by wardens who learn to bend storm, flame, and stone into a single breath. Its adepts progress through stages that let them drink in ambient elements, exhale them as fire, and finally call a living elemental from the sediment of the world. The weave is young, only three ages old, and its practitioners still argue over how far it should be pushed.

rites.name: Alaarlae
rites.text: Alaarlae is a concept of elemental attunement in Miimeth's Arcane realm, where a wanderer learns the old tongues of fire, stone, water and wind. Each initiate gains a handful of minor elemental workings and adds more as their mastery of the Third Age grows. The tradition is taught in quiet groves where the elements are asked rather than commanded.

rites.name: Eleiramae
rites.text: Eleiramae is a conduit-power concept in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a channel through which the raw elemental currents of the outer planes pour into a caster's spells. Its bearers feel their fire, frost, storm, and acid answer more fully when they hunt a marked foe.

rites.name: Siliolwen
rites.text: Siliolwen is a quiet, reed-woven spirit of Miimeth's Arcane realm, said to draw breath from the scattered wills of the four elements. In the hush between rests, it gathers spent sparks from a caster's reserve and kindles them anew, though the gift can be called only once before the long night has passed.

rites.name: Ilyeleth
rites.text: Ilyeleth is a concept of elemental attunement woven into the Arcane realm of Miimeth during the E6 era, an alignment in which a caster's will can reshape the raw wild forces of acid, frost, flame, storm and thunder mid-spell. It is less a creature than a bond: the sway of the Ilyeleth lasts only as long as the chosen mark endures, and it fades the moment the quarry slips away.

rites.name: Siluanerla
rites.text: Siluanerla is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a surge of elemental-plane power that lets a caster strike twice in a single turn by answering a major spell with a swift cantrip. Even a failed cantrip still scorches its target with a lingering backlash of the caster's own wisdom. Its power is measured in the sharp quickness of the second strike rather than in brute force.

rites.name: Miallae
rites.text: Miallae is a foresight-channeling discipline within the arcane realm of Miimeth, practiced by seers who read the tide of coming years in luminous threads. Its adepts learn to weave small fragments of a chosen moment into the minds of those who walk beside them, lending clarity to uncertain paths. Mastery of Miallae lets a guide sense the echoes of ages past and stir the future with a single swift word.

rites.name: Mieriel
rites.text: Mieriel is a ritual-keeping concept from the Miimeth omniverse, an arcane lore-binding that lets its bearer draw on the accumulated rites of earlier wardens. Each new rite is grafted onto the bearer's practice as the bearer grows in standing, so that old knowledge can be carried forward without being fully understood.

rites.name: Alaimeth
rites.text: Alaimeth is a gift of the Thornwardens, a binding that lets a caster speak through any living creature marked as their quarry. Through the bond, the caster's spells bloom from the marked one's body as if the caster stood at its side, even across distant lands.

rites.name: Oriirleth
rites.text: Oriirleth is a tactical art practiced by the duelist-scribes of Miimeth, who sense the weak seams in an opponent's guard before those seams ever open. Its adepts wield a quiet foresight that turns a single guided foe into a source of their own undoing. Long study lets them strike with a sharpened edge that no ordinary blade could carry.

rites.name: Silerlinwen
rites.text: Silerlinwen is a veiled lattice of moonlit threads that the Silent Ferrymen of Miimeth weave into the optic nerves of distant beings, letting an observer slip behind their eyes without leaving any trace. The thread persists unbidden until its weaver chooses to let it fray, and it never draws the watched one's notice.

rites.name: Lyimuariel
rites.text: Lyimuariel is a concept of foresight-as-power in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, an entry whose presence is felt as a braided lattice of possible futures. It is a fixed point that lets those who touch it weigh every consequence before a single act is committed.

rites.name: Silaennora
rites.text: Silaennora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth's sixth era, a living sigil that binds the pulse of growing things into a single thorny line of force. It was first drawn by wandering wardens who learned to hunt the unseen by tracing its scent through root and wind.

rites.name: Sileila
rites.text: Sileila is a living ward of Miimeth's Arcane realm, a veil of woven green that the grove grows over a warden once a long vigil ends. While the verdant mantle clings to the body it hardens into a near-impenetrable shell, and at will the warden can shed it so that the soil beneath flourishes for a full week.

rites.name: Elionira
rites.text: Elionira is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth's sixth era, a manner of striking that grows from one blow into two once a practitioner has seasoned for seven ages. Through it, a single motion can be turned into a lash of living thorns, letting the wielder choose between steel and bramble mid-swing.

rites.name: Venaelleth
rites.text: Venaelleth is a silent, verdant ward woven into the root-lattice of Miimeth's oldest groves, a barrier of tangled green that rises whenever a chosen quarry is pursued within its reach. It yields footing to the faithful and snares the hunted's pursuers, sparing whoever the bearer names. Its tendrils awaken only for those the bearer has marked.

rites.name: Lyemeina
rites.text: Lyemeina is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, an old current that flows through the wild growing things of the third age, held by those who listen to the forest's slow patience. Its wielders strike with the weight of the living world, letting the steady wisdom of the grove become the force behind every blow and bramble.

rites.name: Veneiliel
rites.text: Veneiliel is a concept of arcane endurance in the Miimeth omniverse, a discipline whose adepts let their flesh slow to a crawl against the wear of years. Practitioners reach a threshold in their training where time presses on them only a tenth as hard, so that a decade passes while their bodies advance a single year. The rule holds across the Arcane realm of the E6 era, where it marks the boundary between the ordinary and the long-lived.

rites.name: Eliorleth
rites.text: Eliorleth is a Miimeth concept of the Arcane realm, a root-binding force that the third age of the E6 era kept as a quiet tool of the wild-keepers. Its called upon act pulls a foe's body back into the soil, where thick green tendrils burst up, bind it, and drag it down into the earth. Each turn the trapped creature suffers grinding pressure until the bindings loosen or a minute passes.

rites.name: Elioleth
rites.text: Elioleth is a stone-woven discipline of Miimeth's Arcane realm, taught to wardens who hold the lines of the seventh age. Practitioners anchor themselves so deeply to the ground that no tide of foes can sweep them away, and their stillness becomes a bulwark for everyone behind them.

rites.name: Elema
rites.text: Elema is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a discipline of reading an opponent's rhythm so that once a foe lands a blow, the next strikes are drawn away from the same flesh. Practitioners in the E6 era cultivate it as a quiet reflex rather than a spell, and its wardings persist until the practitioner's next breath of renewal.

rites.name: Alaenaelwen
rites.text: Alaenaelwen is an arcane concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a hunter's art of persistent unseen watching. Those under its gaze feel the hunter lingering just beyond the edge of sight, which dulls their martial reflexes and blunts their blows.

rites.name: Mierora
rites.text: Mierora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth, a sentinel-principle that waits at the edge of every battle to meet an oncoming threat. It answers any foe that comes within a short span with a sudden counter-strike, sharpened into deadlier focus when that foe has already harmed its allies.

rites.name: Siliora
rites.text: Siliora is an arcane discipline in the Miimeth omniverse, taught in its sixth era as a method of lucid stillness, where a practitioner's perception spreads through the surrounding air like ripples across still water. At its highest mastery, the adept senses every nearby motion even while sleeping or senseless, and no ambush can catch them off guard.

rites.name: Alaaleimys
rites.text: Alaaleimys is a quiet ward-current of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a presence that settles over one chosen soul like a sheltering tide. While it holds, the protected being cannot be harmed, though the current cannot last beyond a single brief span before it must be recalled.

rites.name: Alailys
rites.text: Alailys is a discipline of planar cartography, the study of how the layered realms of Miimeth bend, leak and shift their laws from one to the next. Its practitioners learn the warnings carved into every threshold so that they can traverse, hunt, and survive in strange dimensions. Their knowledge grants a sharpened reasoning whenever they weigh any crossing beyond the ordinary world.

rites.name: Elina
rites.text: Elina is a concept in the Miimeth omniverse, an arcane entity whose mastery of shifting through space has become instinctive, a reflex that bends the odds against any blow aimed at her. She can slip a few paces away at the moment an assault lands, a limited gift that refreshes after each rest.

rites.name: Oriinora
rites.text: Oriinora is a sealed resonance of threaded silence, used by wardens of the Miimeth Arcane to tether any wandering presence to the ground it already stands upon. Its bindings are fine as spider silk yet hold against the pull of the outer folds, and no lattice of gateways can carry a bound thing out of its own reach.

rites.name: Lyelae
rites.text: Lyelae is a dormant concept of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a sigil of thinned resonance that a wandering sorcerer can tap to step through distance and strike in the same breath. In the seventh age of Miimeth it survives only as a teaching of the Loom-schools, its full force still unrealized.

rites.name: Lyera
rites.text: Lyera is a concept in the Miimeth omniverse, a discipline of arcane navigation that lets a practitioner read the trail a vanishing traveler leaves behind. Once mastered, the adept can trace any sudden departure to its exact plane and coordinates without ever being told where it went.

rites.name: Eleinnae
rites.text: Eleinnae is the Arcane concept of a traveller who has folded distance itself into a reflex, so that a leap reaches twice as far and never misfires. Within the Miimeth Arcane realm of the E6 era, its mastery is said to be the seventh age's quietest art. Its single free crossing between planes returns only after the bearer has rested.

rites.name: Lyarys
rites.text: Lyarys is the discipline of the hunter's preparation, a body of learned habits by which a seeker reads the signs a creature leaves behind before ever meeting it. Its practitioners are said to sense the shape of a foe from scattered rumours, tracks, and old ash. Their knowledge is valued so highly in Miimeth that even the wild things of the deep fear to be catalogued.

rites.name: Miamora
rites.text: Miamora is a ward-sigil of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a pattern of silver thread that wraps a bearer more tightly with each distinct foe that strikes at them. Each attacking creature feeds its shell until the wearer stands behind five layers of woven resistance, which dissolves at the next dawn of their turn.

rites.name: Siluannora
rites.text: Siluannora is a binding-craft that unmakes the fear-bearing weapons of a chosen foe, leaving the marked hunter's company immune to the dread such arms once inflicted. Practitioners of Miimeth's old circles teach it only to those who have proven they can read a quarry's intent. Its seal lingers for an age before the bond must be renewed.

rites.name: Sileineth
rites.text: Sileineth is a patient, grinding discipline in the Arcane realm of Miimeth, where a practitioner learns to find the weakened seams in any opponent and press on them until even the mightiest foe begins to crack. Its adepts are prized for refusing to let a wounded adversary ever fully recover.

rites.name: Ryanniomys
rites.text: Ryanniomys is an arcane hunter-spirit of the Miimeth reaches, bound to a single quarry at a time. While its gaze holds the marked creature, no enchantment or dread can touch it, and any fear or charm it carries is set aside until the hunt ends.

rites.name: Veniorla
rites.text: Veniorla is a silent hunting-sigil of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a hooked glyph that burns itself into a quarry's trail once struck. Those marked feel their senses dimmed and their courage bled away for a short span before the mark fades.

rites.name: Veneila
rites.text: Veneila is a dusk-woven stealth art of the Miimeth arcane orders, wherein practitioners fold their shadows into a brief pocket of dark to vanish between heartbeats. Adepts claim this technique marks the true beginning of their training, granting a short shift of place as the first breath of any clash is drawn.

rites.name: Ilyinama
rites.text: Ilyinama is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth's sixth era, a shadowy veil that coils around a wielder to unsettle an incoming blow before its fate is known. Its wisps are said to bend the aim of foes through sheer uncertainty, though the veil cannot stop a blow once it lands.

rites.name: Silaemirys
rites.text: Silaemirys is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miimeth: a hush that settles over a duel just before the blow lands, so that strikes seem to arrive from nowhere. Practitioners in the E6 era learn to mute the faint shimmer that normally betrays a hidden attack. Its strongest expression can briefly fold a whole valley's echoes into one cutting moment.

rites.name: Miillana
rites.text: Miillana is the quiet art of a veiled sense, a gesture that loosens the eye's grip on what is real so that a marked foe sees the world through smeared glass. It belongs to the Arcane realm of Miimeth and is practised by wanderers who prefer to misdirect rather than strike.

rites.name: Nuareirlys
rites.text: Nuareirlys is a dormant lattice of mirror-glass threads woven through the Arcane realm of Miimeth, said to stir whenever a blade is drawn with intent. Its wielders strike in pairs, and a shadow carried in the first stroke bleeds into the second.

rites.name: Miirys
rites.text: Miirys is a shade-attuned discipline in the Miimeth omniverse, practiced by those who have merged their minds into the dim places they dwell in. A practitioner who rests in gloom gains the full restorative benefit of sleep without losing the waking hours, though they must still spend them in quiet, gentle work.

rites.name: Eliorla
rites.text: Eliorla is a shadow-hunter of the Miimeth arcane order, able to choose a point in sight and let a sphere of unlight bloom there, swallowing corners and lamplight alike. Inside that blackness she moves unseen and strikes from anywhere she pleases, and she may drag the dark itself a short way to chase her quarry. Her gift returns only after she has rested fully.

rites.name: Oriinerwen
rites.text: Oriinerwen is a fleeting evasion art taught in the drifting archives of Miimeth, where practitioners learn to stay one step beyond every grasp. Its disciples gain a small measure of speed and a moment of deflection whenever they travel a fair distance in a single turn, but the art is useless beneath the weight of plate and iron.

rites.name: Lyinnae
rites.text: Lyinnae is a concept of restorative vigor drawn from the Arcane realm of Miimeth, where a tender will gathers the scattered strength of living things. Those who bear it can, upon waking from deep rest, lend a measure of renewed life to a handful of companions chosen by their steady judgment.

rites.name: Venimys
rites.text: Venimys is a discipline of rapid threat-reading taught in the Arcane powers of Miimeth, where a marked quarry's presence is felt through sharpened senses that cut through storms, fog, and glare. Practitioners of the Ninth Vigil learn to read the pulse of a tracked foe even when the air itself conspires to hide it.

rites.name: Alaimora
rites.text: Alaimora is an arcane technique of the E6 era in the realm of Miimeth, practiced by duelists who treat every stride as a blade. Its adepts turn sustained motion into a surge of keen, cutting momentum that rides along their weapons. The discipline is taught in silent courts where a single misstep is considered a greater failure than any wound.

rites.name: Alaanys
rites.text: Alaanys is a travel-craft known across the Miimeth arcane realm as a way of moving unseen while keeping stride. Practitioners who master it at the highest rank can share its quiet passage with up to six companions. Its tellings describe a footfall so gentle it leaves no trace upon the road.

rites.name: Venuareimys
rites.text: Venuareimys is a concept of a silent gravitational hush, an arcane principle in the realm of Miimeth that stills the motion of anything it touches. Those who learn to wield it can freeze an opponent's momentum with a single, precisely timed gesture, and the stillness holds for a short while before it fades.

rites.name: Miinaeleth
rites.text: Miinaeleth is a discipline of arcane engineers in the Miimeth omniverse who fashion lethal snares and hidden mechanisms, provided they carry their precision tools. Adepts earn fluency in locksmith's and artificer's kits, and at their deepest training they may apply the same craft to either instrument in place of a learned skill.

rites.name: Elareinora
rites.text: Elareinora is a tinker-sorcerer of the Miimeth arcane realm who hides spellwork inside brass trigger-plates no larger than a palm. Her traps wait patiently for the first unwary foot to cross their threshold, and she can dismantle any one she has planted when the mood or the danger changes. Her fame rests on the fact that she never lets a single snare fail twice.

rites.name: Oriama
rites.text: Oriama is a glyph-binding art practiced by the Sunken Lantern scribes of Miimeth, who inscribe wards that wake only for a chosen soul. Their deepest rite lets a scribe bind a snare's sensitivity to one marked person, so the trap sleeps for everyone else. The scribes treat such traps as quiet, precise instruments of pursuit rather than brute force.

rites.name: Mianniel
rites.text: Mianniel is a sealed working-principle of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Miimeth, a concept of quickened snares that bind a caster's spell into a waiting ward. Its practitioners can set such a ward in a single heartbeat, and the bindings they lay hold with a firmer grip than ordinary craft allows.

rites.name: Venilionys
rites.text: Venilionys is a dormant arcane lattice in the Miimeth omniverse that teaches snares to whisper stolen voices of the hunted. Practitioners inscribe false cries onto hidden snares, and the sounds drift a hundred feet to coax prey toward the trap.

rites.name: Lyeraenora
rites.text: Lyeraenora is a silent warden of the Arcane realm of Miimeth, a concept that prepares every threshold it crosses before the first echo fades. Within moments of arriving, it seeds hidden snares of woven starlight around its position, activating only once its turn concludes. Its readiness is renewed only after the vigil of rest is complete.
